Parameters.ParameterEn: Good evening.
Webb asked me to come.

Words: 晚上好。
Good evening...
Webb 约了我。
Webb... set this up for me...
今晚有包厢吗，先生？
Got... a private room tonight, sir?...
我来找酒吧老板。他约了我今晚来谈点事。
I'm here to see the owner... He set this up for tonight...
今晚有包厢吗，先生？
Got... a private room tonight, sir?...
喂——我说，是你们老板Webb 约的我——
Hey—... come on, Webb invited me—
今晚有包厢吗，先生。
Got... a private room tonight, sir...
...Ah, hell...
下次喊我来之前先和你的门卫说一声啊，Webb 先生。
Next time... tell your doorman before you summon me, Mr. Webb...
等等！
Oh— wait! Wait a moment...
先别急着走！
Don't leave just yet... hold on...
请问今晚有包厢吗，小姐？
Got... a private room tonight, miss?...
艾斯弗德的 King Oliver 派我们来的（King Oliver from Ashford sent us）。
King Oliver from Ashford... sent us...
晚上好！两位请进！刚才多有怠慢，还请包涵。
Ah, good evening! Please... come in, both of you! Forgive my earlier rudeness...
你是谁？
Who... are you?...
先进来再说。
We'll talk inside...

Parameters.ParameterStr: 刚才在门口，你为什么帮我？
Parameters.ParameterEn: Why did you help me at the door?
That password--where did you get it?

Words: 你刚刚站在那扇门前，提到了一个我追了三个月的名字——Webb。
You just stood out there... and mentioned a name I've been chasing for three months — Webb...
我的线人三个月前给我的——和 Webb 这个名字一起。
My informant gave it to me three months ago... along with Webb's name...
重新认识一下，我是Emma O'Malley,职业是——
Let me start over... I'm Emma O'Malley, and my profession is—
记者。带着速记本，一身还没散尽的油墨味。不太擅长喝酒……却待在酒吧里。
A reporter. Stenographer's pad... a smudge of ink still on your cuff. Not much of a drinker... and yet here you are at a bar...
你是为了酒吧老板——Webb而来的。
You're here for the owner of this place... Webb...
真讨厌你们这些私家侦探对细节极度敏锐的毛病，
God... I hate that habit you private eyes have -- picking up on every little detail...
在你们面前一点成就感都没有。
There's just no winning with you people...

Parameters.ParameterEn: Likewise.

Parameters.ParameterStr: 你能追上三个月，和私家侦探比也不逞多让了。
Parameters.ParameterEn: You kept at it for three months. Not bad for someone who's not a private eye.

Words: 说得倒轻巧。
Easy for you to say...
我只是喜欢自己探寻事实而已。
I just like uncovering the truth myself...
作为记者，我可是做足了功课的——我知道你是谁，Brennan 先生。
As a reporter, I've done my homework... I know who you are, Mr. Brennan...
你在邮局能见到的人，我可全都盘了一遍。
Everyone you've met at the post office... I've already gone through them all...
据我所知，你最近收到了一封来自他的委托信？
From what I hear... you recently received a commission letter from him?...
只是一封挂号信。我还没见过他本人。你要是想捞点独家新闻，恐怕找错了人。
Just a registered letter... I haven't even met the man. If you're after an exclusive... you've come to the wrong guy...
这个酒吧——你知道里面是什么结构吗？
This bar... do you actually know the layout in there?...
光靠你一个人，有的人问不到，有的门敲不开。
Alone... there are people you can't reach, doors that won't open for you...
让我报道一些真相，和好故事。
Let me report some truths... and some good stories...
只要你能给我这个——这个酒吧里有更多需要我来帮忙协调的事，我很乐意。
As long as you can give me that... whatever in this bar needs coordinating, I'm glad to help...

Parameters.ParameterEn: Name your terms.

Parameters.ParameterStr: 你为什么盯着 Webb 这条线？
Parameters.ParameterEn: Why are you following the Webb lead?

Words: 独家报道权。你发现了什么，第一个告诉我。
Exclusive rights... Whatever you find, I'm the first to know...
三个月前，一个查账的稽查员跟我提到了 Webb——他说这男人手腕极硬，
Three months ago... a tax inspector mentioned Webb to me — said this man had an iron grip...
南区大半的地下生意都按他的规矩转。
Half the underground business in the South Side runs by his rules...
结果第二天，那个稽查员就连夜搬出了艾斯弗德。
The very next day... that inspector packed up and left Ashford overnight...
能用这种雷霆手段让人闭嘴，他绝不是个和善的酒吧老板。
Someone who can silence people with that kind of speed... he's no friendly barkeep...
我想，这地方一定有点什么好料。
I figured this place must be hiding something good...
好吧。委托信里写的是遗嘱嘱托——
Alright... The commission letter said it's an estate matter --
他要我确保一个叫 Vivian 的姑娘，顺利继承他的遗产。
He wants me to make sure a girl named Vivian inherits his estate smoothly...
我今晚来，是准备找到 Webb，把遗嘱委托的合同正式拿到手。
I came tonight to find Webb... and get the contract for that estate trust officially in hand...
……遗嘱？这不可能。Webb 约莫五十岁，正是手腕最硬、野心最大的年纪。
...An estate? That can't be right. Webb is around fifty... right at the peak of his power and ambition...
一个大权在握的操盘手，怎么会突然安排后事？
A man with that kind of grip... suddenly arranging his affairs?...
除非他——
Unless he--
……除非他预感自己会被人谋杀。
...Unless he... sensed that someone was going to murder him...
啊
枪声是在哪边？
Where did the gunshot come from?...
听上去像是……在 Webb 的会客室。
Sounds like... it came from Webb's parlor...
先生——是她！Vivian Gray！
Sir—... it's her! Vivian Gray!...
Vivian Gray?
Vivian Gray?...
哦……恐怕，她就是Webb遗嘱里的那个继承人了。
Oh... I'm afraid... she's the heir from Webb's estate...
她手里拿着枪——她一定是刚刚杀了 Webb 先生！
She had a gun in her hand— she must have just killed Mr. Webb!...
她手里有枪——但看枪口的样子，Brennan。
She has a gun in her hand—but look at the muzzle, Brennan...
枪口看着很干净。
The barrel looks clean...
让一让。
Step aside...
见鬼……Webb。哪个混蛋把你打成了这样？
Christ... Webb. What bastard did this to you?
你们两个——是什么人？案发现场，闲杂人等得先出去。
You two— who are you? This is a crime scene... civilians need to clear out...
Zack Brennan。O'Malley小姐的记者助理。
Zack Brennan. Miss O'Malley's... reporting assistant...
哈？
Huh?...
助理？嗯？那么，那位记者小姐呢？是你吗？
Assistant? Huh?... So which one of you is the reporter? You?...
呃……Emma O'Malley。记者。《艾斯弗德先驱报》，的记者。
Uh... Emma O'Malley. Reporter. The Ashford Herald...
《艾斯弗德先驱报》……行，采访权给你们。
The Ashford Herald... fine. You can have your interview...
现场你们可以看，人你们可以问——但拿到你们要的东西就走。
You can look at the scene, you can ask your questions... But take what you came for and leave...
这不是报社的茶水间。
This isn't your newspaper's lunch room...
Webb 先生，一枪毙命。
Mr. Webb-- one shot, dead on the spot...
这姑娘——手里拿着枪，在场……哎，这案子不就结了吗？
This girl-- had the gun in her hand, right here at the scene... hah, case closed, isn't it?...
Brennan，助理先生。你看上去倒比我还专业哈。
Brennan, Mr. Assistant... you look more like a real detective than I do, hah...
见谅，为了保证报道的完整性……这边——我总得都问问。
My apologies, sir... for the sake of complete reporting... I do need to ask around...

Parameters.ParameterStr: 辖区是哪个？警徽号——我要在笔记里记一下。
Parameters.ParameterEn: Which precinct? Badge number--I need it for my notes.

Parameters.ParameterStr: 能请您详细分析一下Webb先生的情况吗？
Parameters.ParameterEn: Could you give me a detailed assessment of Mr. Webb's condition?
No more questions.

Words: 请问您的辖区是哪个？警徽号——我要在笔记里记一下。
Which precinct are you with? And your badge number... I need it for the notes...
你问这个做什么？
What do you want that for?...
要是破了案子，《艾斯弗德先驱报》的读者们，
Well, if the case gets solved and Ashford Herald readers...
却都不知道您的名字，那可就糟糕了！
...don't even know your name -- that would be a real shame!...
二十二分局，警察。Morrison——就这一个姓。
Precinct Twenty-Two, detective. Morrison... just the one name...
这个案子在的这片区都归我管。
Everything in this district falls under me...
你跟 Webb 认识？
So you knew Webb?...
认识，酒吧里的员工我也都认识。
I knew him. I know all the staff in the bar too...
……可有什么区别吗？他现在死了，这只能就是个案子。
...what difference does it make? He's dead now. It's just a case...
我还欠他半个月的酒钱。……这帐大概是想结也结不了咯。
He still owed me half a month's bar tab... guess that debt's never getting settled now, huh...
能请您详细分析一下Webb先生的情况吗？
Could you give me a detailed assessment of Mr. Webb's condition?
Webb死了，毋庸置疑，Brennan。
Webb is dead. No question about it, Brennan.
我本来该去打牌。现在得陪这具尸体耗到天亮——真他妈走运。
I was supposed to be at a card game. Now I am stuck with a corpse till dawn. Just my goddamn luck.
总之。我现在接案，Webb 死亡，
Anyway. I'm on the case now. Webb dead...
枪响时间 23:30，地点在会客室——就这些。
Gunshot at 23:30, location the parlor room... that's the lot...
你打算怎么处理这个案子？
How are you planning to handle this case?...
Rosa 说的那番话……有人持枪，有人指认，够了。
What Rosa said... someone with a gun, an eyewitness. That's enough...
准备先把 Gray小姐带走，就这样收了。
Taking Miss Gray in and wrapping this up...
就这两条？
Just those two things?...
有人指认，有人手持凶器。
Eyewitness identification, suspect holding the weapon...
Brennan，我现在要抓第一嫌疑人，不是陪你写他妈的论文。
Brennan, I am here to arrest the prime suspect, not help you write a goddamn thesis.
你们要看就看。拿到需要的东西了就离开这儿。
You can look around. Get what you need and then get out...
多少时间？
How much time?...
够你查的时间。
Enough for you to do your digging...
别踩那边，我还没做完记录。
Don't step over there. I'm not done with my notes...
受某人所雇佣——我是他的遗产委托侦探。
Hired by a certain someone — I'm his estate trustee detective...
侦……侦探？
D-detective...?
O'Malley小姐，这是什么意思？
Miss O'Malley, what is this supposed to mean...?
先别急，您可以看看委托书的内容。
Take it easy, officer... why don't you have a look at what's in the document...
Webb 和 Brennan 的委托协议...
Webb and Brennan's commission agreement...
Gray小姐...Webb的遗产继承权...
Miss Gray... Webb's estate... inheritance rights...
Webb 委托Brennan先生执行他的遗嘱——继承人是 Gray小姐。
Webb commissioned Mr. Brennan to execute his will — the heir is Miss Gray...
而这是他生前和这位Zack Brennan签下的委托协议书。
And this is the commission agreement he signed with Mr. Brennan... while he was still alive...
Morrison，你觉得Webb这个人，
Morrison... do you really think Webb...
没有任何理由，会突然给自己安排后事吗？
...with no reason at all, would suddenly arrange his own affairs?...
……你想说什么，Brennan？
...What are you getting at, Brennan...?
Gray 若被定罪谋杀 Webb，遗嘱即废——杀人者不得继承被害人的遗产。
If Gray is convicted of murdering Webb, the will is void — a killer cannot inherit from their victim...
这一切发生得太顺理成章了，
This all happened far too neatly...
简直像是有人刻意把这把枪和谋杀的罪名塞到了她手里。
...almost as if someone deliberately placed that gun and the charge of murder into her hands...
我是生前合法的遗嘱委托侦探，拥有将这件事彻查到底的法律权利。
I'm the legally appointed estate trustee detective... and I have the legal right to see this investigation through to the end...
Morrison先生，
Mr. Morrison...
您总不能在委托还没执行完之前，就把遗嘱继承人关进去。
Surely you can't, before the deceased's final commission has even been carried out... just lock up the heir...
……七十二小时。如果你们找不出别的结论，我就按我看到的办。
...Seventy-two hours. If you can't come up with anything else... I close it the way I see it...
我现在要单独、仔细地问问在场的两个人。
I'm going to question the two people who were present -- separately, and thoroughly...
那个 Gray小姐，还有那个清洁工。
That Miss Gray... and the cleaner...
你先去问你该问的——酒吧里还有其他员工。
You go ask around -- there are other staff in the bar...
等我这边谈完了，再和你聊现场的事。
Once I'm done talking here... we can discuss the scene...
走吧。我们还有时间。
Let's go... we still have time...
好。
Right.
哦——对不起先生！我...我是 Rosa，Rosa Martinez。
Oh... I'm sorry, sir! I... I'm Rosa, Rosa Martinez...
就是...就是做清洁的。
I'm just... just the cleaning lady...
你在这里做什么。
What are you doing here...
我...月底了，Webb 先生要求彻底清洁。
I... end of the month, Mr. Webb wanted a thorough cleaning...
我一直在走廊那边打扫...然后...然后听到了枪声。
I was in the hallway the whole time... scrubbing... then... then I heard the gunshot...
走廊尽头，就在这边，靠近会客室这一侧。
At the end of the hallway, right here... on this side, near the parlor...
所以我在场，先生。
So I was there, sir!...
我有资格说——我是……我是……女巫（Witches）!
I have the right to say -- I am a... a witch... Witch!...
那是目击者（Witness）。
That's witness...
...哦，哦，目击者（Witness）。
...oh, oh, witness. Witness...
你说她杀了人。
You said she killed him...

Parameters.ParameterEn: Did you actually see her fire the gun?

Parameters.ParameterStr: 23:30 那一声——你在哪儿听到的？
Parameters.ParameterEn: That shot at 23:30--where did you hear it?
No more questions.

Words: 你说 Gray 杀了 Webb。你亲眼看见她开枪了？
You said Gray killed Webb. Did you actually see her fire the gun?...
我...我是说...她手里有枪。那把枪。
I... I'm saying... she had the gun. That gun...
Webb 先生就死在那里。然后...
Mr. Webb... he died right there. And then...
谁手里拿着枪，就是谁做的，先生。这...这是明摆着的事。
Whoever is holding the gun... that's who did it, sir. It's... it's obvious...
她此刻手里正拿着那把枪。她一定是刚刚杀了 Webb 先生。
She is holding that gun right now. She must have just killed Mr. Webb...
你没有回答我的问题。
You didn't answer my question...
先生...我只知道我看到的。
Sir... I only know what I saw...
那声枪响。23:30——你在哪里？
That gunshot. 23:30... where were you?...
走廊那头...我一直在走廊那头，先生。打扫。就是...就是那一声。
Down the hallway... I was at the far end of the hallway, sir. Cleaning. It was just... just that one shot...
那一声之前呢？还有别的动静吗？
Before that shot... any other sounds? Anything at all?...
有……枪响以后，我还听见玻璃碎掉的声音。除此以外，没有别的动静。
Yes... After the gunshot, I heard glass shatter. Other than that, there was nothing else.
那之前会客室那边都是安静的...就...就只有那一声，先生。
Before that it was all quiet near the parlor... just... just that one shot, sir...
而且...那个时候。里面只有她，就只有 Gray小姐在里面。
And... at that moment... only she was in there. Only Miss Gray was inside...
所以...所以只能是她。
So... so it can only be her...
你说话听起来，像是事先想好了要说这几句。
The way you're talking... it sounds like you had all that prepared beforehand...
我...我就是说了我知道的事，先生。
I... I just told you what I know, sir...
就这些了？
That's everything?...
就这些。我看见的，就这些，先生。
That's everything. What I saw... that's everything, sir...
刚才听到了你的名字——你是 Vivian Gray吗？
I just heard your name... you're Vivian Gray?...
Mm...
你好，我是 Zack Brennan。Webb 雇的侦探。
Hello. I'm Zack Brennan. A detective hired by Webb...
……Webb？
他委托我来处理一件遗产的事。
He hired me to handle an estate matter...
But... he...
他倒在地板上……
He's lying on the floor...

Parameters.ParameterEn: Did you fire this gun?
This gun--is it yours?
No more questions.

Words: 你有没有开过这把枪？
Did you fire this gun?...
我……我不……
I... I don't...
……不知道。
...I don't know...
好。
Alright...
这把枪——是你的吗？
This gun... is it yours?...
Yes...
你在这里是做什么的？
What do you do here?...
蓝月亮的……歌女。
Blue Moon's... singer...
你是这里的歌女？
You're the singer here?...
她没法回答。先这样。
She can't answer. Let's leave it here for now...
Rosa。你刚才说——Gray 手里拿着手枪，她一定是刚刚杀了 Webb。
Rosa. You just said — Gray was holding a pistol, that she must have just killed Webb...
是...是的，先生。她就拿着那把枪，
Y-yes, sir! She was holding that gun...
Webb先生又刚刚死了——这还不够明显吗？
...and Mr. Webb just died -- isn't that obvious enough?!...
先别急着下定论。如果你真的看清了，就再把刚才的话重复一遍。
Don't be in such a hurry to draw conclusions. If you really did see it clearly, say it again...
我说多少遍都是一样的！
No matter how many times you ask, it's the same!...
她此刻手里正拿着一把手枪，她一定是刚刚开枪杀了 Webb 先生。
She's holding a pistol right now -- she must have just shot and killed Mr. Webb!...
可她的枪管里没有硝烟残留，没有黑化痕迹……至少刚刚没有被击发过。
But there's no gunpowder residue in the barrel, no fouling marks... this gun hasn't been fired recently...
嘿！你从哪里拿到这把枪的！
Hey! Where did you get that gun?!...
Morrison, Rosa 说“刚刚杀了”。可这把枪，和那句话，对不上。
Morrison. Rosa said 'just killed.' But this gun... and those words... don't add up...
这是非法搜证……没有经过局子里正式的弹道检验！我不认同！
This is illegal evidence collection... no proper ballistic test from the precinct! I won't accept this...!
你难道看不出来吗？
You really can't see it...?
……确实没有硝烟反应，Rosa? 你确定你真的看到了吗？
...There really is no powder residue. Rosa? You sure... you actually saw it...?
那...那硝烟是可以消散的！或者她用的是...是别的...
B-but... the gunpowder can dissipate! Or maybe she used... used something... else...
这里可没有别的手枪。
There's no other pistol here...
那得我搜完才能下定论。
I'll only know for sure once I've finished searching...
Morrison先生！相信我！
Mr. Morrison! Believe me!
相信你？可Gray刚刚并没有开枪，你怎么能证明一定是她杀的？
Believe you? But Gray didn't fire that gun just now — so how can you prove it was her...?
枪声刚响起来的时候，我就来门口了。
When the shot rang out, I came straight to the door...
那时候Webb 先生身边只有 Gray小姐，没有别人……
At that moment, only Miss Gray was beside Mr. Webb... nobody else...
就算她不是用这把枪，也一定...一定是她杀的！
Even if she didn't use that gun — it still... it must have been her...!
而且，23:30，大家都听到了，只有那一声枪声。
And — 23:30, everyone heard it. There was only that one gunshot...
大家都可以作证的……是吧？Morrison先生？
Everyone can attest to it... right...? Mr. Morrison...?
今晚我一直在吧台那边。23:30，枪声只响了那一次。
I was over at the bar all night. 23:30, the shot rang out just that once...
你和O'Malley小姐上来的时候，
When you and Miss O'Malley came upstairs...
这房间里也只有Gray小姐拿着枪吧？
...only Miss Gray was in this room holding the gun... correct?...
23:30 一定是Webb死亡的枪响。
The shot at 23:30 must have been the one that killed Mr. Webb...
我亲耳听到，那会儿只有Gray小姐在里面。
I heard it with my own ears -- only Miss Gray was inside at that moment...
Morrison，Rosa，我想先请两位看看这个。
Morrison. Rosa. I'd like you both to take a look at this...
