晚上还要备菜。
Still got prep to do tonight...
请进，Brennan 先生。
Come in, Mr. Brennan...
我在盘今晚的账——您懂的，不管出了多大的事，账总是要算的。
I was going over tonight's books -- you understand, no matter what happens, the numbers still have to add up...
你认识我？
You know who I am?...
Morrison 先生特意叮嘱过了，要我配合调查。
Mr. Morrison gave me a heads-up. Told me to cooperate with the investigation...
那希望我们今晚的谈话会顺利。
Then let's hope our conversation tonight goes smoothly...
当然，您问，我答。干我们这行的，最懂得怎么配合。
Of course. You ask, I answer. In my line of work, we know how to play along...

Parameters.ParameterStr: Webb 死后，蓝月亮这么大的场子归谁管？
Parameters.ParameterEn: With Webb dead, who's running a joint this big?

Parameters.ParameterStr: 刚才看了一眼，这几天的生意看着不错。
Parameters.ParameterEn: Business has looked pretty good these past few days.
That gunshot tonight--bit noisy, wasn't it?
No more questions.

Words: Webb 死后，蓝月亮这么大的场子归谁管？
With Webb dead, who's running a joint this big?...
法律上来说，Webb 先生的遗嘱里把这里留给了 Gray小姐。
Legally speaking, Mr. Webb's will leaves this place to Miss Gray...
但现在事情会变成什么样，也不好说。
But how things will turn out from here... hard to say...
你这消息倒是灵通。
You're awfully well-informed...
我是个账房，Brennan先生。
I'm a bookkeeper, Mr. Brennan...
不管Webb先生有没有交代，数字我总是算得清。
Whether or not Mr. Webb left instructions... I always keep the numbers straight...
实际上，排班、库存、调度……还有这桌上的账目。
In fact... scheduling, inventory, logistics... and the accounts sitting right here on this desk...
这些琐事以前是我替 Webb 先生操心，
These little chores... used to be my job handling them for Mr. Webb...
以后，不管老板是谁，自然也得是我来打理。
Going forward, whoever the new boss may be... naturally, I'll be the one managing things...
看来他很信任你。
Sounds like he trusted you quite a bit...
我在这儿干了五年，先生。我只对账本负责——数字不撒谎。
I've been here five years, sir. I answer only to the ledger... numbers don't lie...
账目出问题，那是账房的失职。
If the books are off, that's the bookkeeper's fault...
尽职尽责。
Dedicated...
混口饭吃罢了，Brennan 先生。
Just making a living, Mr. Brennan...
刚才在外面看了一眼，这几天的生意看着不错。都是些阔气的主顾。
Had a look around outside just now. Business seems good these past few days. Lot of well-heeled clientele...
得感谢他们。在这年头，人们总需要个放松的地方。
We owe it to them. In times like these, people need somewhere to unwind...
怎么，刚才在门口碰上安保，我可没觉得他们把我当主顾。
Funny. I ran into security at the door and they didn't exactly treat me like a guest...
实在抱歉，底下人没规矩。
My sincere apologies. The boys downstairs can be rough around the edges...
如果您有偏好的牌子，稍后去酒窖挑两瓶，算在我账上。
If you have a preferred label, stop by the cellar later and pick out a couple of bottles -- put them on my tab...
等您下次光顾，我们再好好招待。
Next time you drop by, we'll give you the proper welcome...
蓝月亮供的都是地道的加拿大威士忌，Webb 先生亲自选的招牌。
The Blue Moon stocks nothing but genuine Canadian whiskey. Mr. Webb handpicked it himself... our signature...
所以，这就是全部了？靠卖私酒支撑这么大的场子？
So that's all there is? Running a joint this size on bootleg alone?...
只有私酒。这里做的都是正经买卖，Brennan 先生。
Just bootleg. Everything here is a legitimate operation, Mr. Brennan...
账面上干干净净？
Books all clean, then?...
我记了五年的账，每一笔都在这上面。您随时可以查。
I've kept the books for five years. Every entry is right here. You're welcome to check anytime...
那我就不客气了。
Don't mind if I do...
今晚的枪声，有点吵吧。
That gunshot tonight... bit noisy, wasn't it...
是听到了。大概 23:30，从南边传来的——厨房和会客室那个方向。
Heard it. Around 23:30, came from the south... the kitchen and parlor direction...
只有那一声？
Just the one shot?...
就一声。这栋楼的隔音我比谁都熟。南边，只响了一声。
Just the one. I know the acoustics in this building better than anyone. From the south. Only one shot...
那个时间，Vivian 在哪？
And at that time... where was Vivian?...
每天晚上，Gray小姐的最后一项任务是给 Webb 先生送酒去会客室。
Every evening, Miss Gray's last duty is to bring Mr. Webb his drink in the parlor...
排班表上一直这么写的。
That's what the shift schedule has always said...
这么说，枪响的时候她刚好在里面。
So you're saying she was right in there when the shot went off...
时间上是巧了点。但那说明不了什么。
The timing was... a coincidence. But that doesn't prove anything...
你觉得她没杀人？
You don't think she did it?...
我觉得什么不重要，Brennan 先生。这些东西，不是账房该管的范围。
What I think doesn't matter, Mr. Brennan. Those things... aren't in a bookkeeper's jurisdiction...
好。暂时就这些。
All right. That's enough for now...
随时欢迎，Brennan 先生。
You're welcome anytime, Mr. Brennan...
这里的房门我一般开着，您什么时候想来都可以。
I usually keep the door open here... you're welcome to stop by whenever you like...
看来你的抽屉里不光有账本。
Looks like your drawer holds more than just ledgers...
这枚弹壳看着有年头了。
This casing looks like it's been around a while...
先生！那是我的私人物品！
Sir! Those are my personal belongings!...
带着底印的警用弹壳？你留着这玩意儿当护身符？
A police-stamped casing with a headstamp? You keep that as a good-luck charm?...
这是我自己的事。跟今晚的案子没半点关系，Brennan 先生。
That's my own business. It's got nothing to do with tonight's case, Mr. Brennan...
请您别乱翻。
Please don't go rummaging through my things...
行。你的地盘。
Fine. Your turf...
花瓶是 Vanderbilt。油画是 Coleman。
The vase is Vanderbilt. The painting is Coleman...
根本没有什么古董，Brennan 先生，这都是档案代号。
There were never any antiques, Mr. Brennan... those are all just codenames...
照片背面的数字，是他们买自己体面的价钱。
The numbers on the back of the photos... that's what they paid to buy back their reputation...
Vanderbilt 掏了四千，Coleman 出了七千……
Vanderbilt paid four thousand. Coleman, seven...
全都是买断勒索照片的封口费。
All of it was hush money... to buy back the blackmail photos...
Gray小姐只是个饵。她……Webb 先生让她进包厢，她就得进去。
Miss Gray was just the bait. She... when Mr. Webb told her to walk into the booth, she walked in...
照相、收钱。这套敲诈流水线，你倒是很熟。
Photos, cash. You seem awfully familiar with this whole shakedown operation...
因为……这摊脏水，一年半以前是我在趟。
Because... a year and a half ago, I was the one wading through this filth...
然后，我挨了一枪，伤了底子，没法继续跑腿了……
Then I... took a bullet. Messed up my constitution. Couldn't run routes anymore...
去年十一月中旬，Webb 先生突然就把这整个买卖都停了。
Mid-November last year, Mr. Webb just... shut the whole operation down. Poured all his energy into something else...
他把精力全扑在别的事上。
He threw himself into other things entirely...
送上门的肥肉，他会嫌多？
Easy money landing in his lap, and he turns it down?...
酒吧里都在传，Rita 最近常来找 Webb。他连生意都顾不上了。
Everyone at the bar says Rita has been visiting Webb often lately. He barely has time for business anymore.
这话听着就像个用来骗傻子的借口。
That sounds like a story made to fool the gullible...
在我们这行，人总会产生一种错觉，以为自己能掌控一切。
In our line of work, people always get this... illusion that they're in control.
但迟早有一天……你会惹上不该惹的人。
But sooner or later... you cross someone you shouldn't have...
比如……“银月帮”（Silver Moon）的 “鲸鱼”（Whale）。
Like... the Silver Moon's Whale...
Webb 最近试图切断和他的交易，甚至私吞了他的一笔资金。
Webb recently tried to cut ties with him... even skimmed a sum from his funds...
在艾斯弗德，这么做就等于是在自掘坟墓。
In Ashford... that's practically digging your own grave...
他急着转移财产，想赶在“鲸鱼”（Whale）动手前逃离艾斯弗德……
He'd been scrambling to move his assets lately... probably trying to get out of Ashford before Whale made his move...
但显然，他晚了一步。
...but clearly, he was one step too late...
所以，Webb 一直在利用 Vivian 做这门勒索生意？
So Webb was using Vivian to run his blackmail business?
是。她只是诱饵，Webb 先生才是收线的人。
Yes. She was only the bait. Mr. Webb was the one pulling the line.
那他为什么把全部遗产留给她？
Then why did he leave his entire estate to her?
……这我回答不了。
...I can't answer that.
算了。我自己去问。
Forget it. I'll ask her myself.
Brennan 先生，您还有什么指教？
Mr. Brennan, was there something else you needed?...
指教谈不上。但我是 Webb 先生指定的遗嘱执行人。
I wouldn't call it instruction. But I am the executor named in Mr. Webb's will...
一旦帮 Gray 洗清嫌疑，她就会是蓝月亮的新老板。
Once I clear Miss Gray's name... she'll be the new owner of the Blue Moon...
如果你现在跟我兜圈子，等她接管了这里，
If you keep running me in circles now... once she takes over this place --
我保证她签的第一份解雇令就是给你的。
I guarantee the first pink slip she signs will have your name on it...
……您要保下 Gray小姐？
...You're going to protect Miss Gray?...
怎么，怕丢饭碗了？
What, afraid of losing your meal ticket?...
……您想知道什么，随便问吧。
...Ask whatever you want. I'll talk...
好。Connelly 先生，你刚才说，酒吧只卖私酒，没做别的营生。
Good. Mr. Connelly... you said earlier that the bar only deals in bootleg liquor. Nothing else...
是啊。干我们这行的，您也懂——私酒是主业，
That's right. In our line of work, you understand... bootleg is the main business --
剩下无非是些排班、演出和入场费的进项。
The rest is just scheduling, shows, and cover charges...
蓝月亮的生意，也就这些。除了私酒这块，其他的账可都是清清白白的。
The Blue Moon's business is just that. Apart from the bootleg... our books are clean as a whistle...
你说账面干净——但这张照片的背面，还藏着一本你没告诉我的账。
You say the books are clean... but the back of this photograph hides a ledger you forgot to mention...
这是用煤油灯烘出来的字：“花瓶四千”，“油画七千”。
These words were brought out with a kerosene lamp. 'Vase... four thousand.' 'Painting... seven thousand.'...
柠檬汁写的，遇热才显形。
Written in lemon juice. Only shows when heated...
这底下藏着的，可不是什么合影记录。
What's hidden underneath... is no ordinary photo album...
这个……
That's... that's...
瞧您说的……有些客人会和酒吧里的姑娘私下往来。
Now, Mr. Brennan... some guests see the women from the club in private.
那也只是客人的个人消遣，和酒吧生意搭不上边。
That is the guest's private amusement. It has nothing to do with the club's business.
咱们的账面上可只有酒水和演出的进项。我们的账，那是清清白白的。
Our books only show revenue from liquor and shows. Our accounts are clean... spotless...
撇得倒干净。如果只是客人的个人消遣，
A tidy distinction. If it was only a guest's private amusement,
照片背面为什么要用隐形墨水明码标价？
...why are there prices written in invisible ink on the back of these photos?...
这种见不得光的巨额交易，难道你就一点都没过手？
These kinds of under-the-table transactions... you're telling me you never handled a single one?...
没错。一分钱的进项、一分钱的开销，全在账上。您要查，账本随时都在这儿。
That's right. Every penny in, every penny out... all on the books. You want to check, the ledger's right here...
那些个人私事，可记不到账本里。酒吧的进项全是干净的。
Personal affairs don't go into the ledger. The bar's income is all clean...
那你来解释解释这个。你的账本上写着四千，Webb的私账上却是一万五千。
Then explain this. Your ledger says four thousand... but Webb's private books show fifteen thousand...
您是从哪翻出来这笔数的……
Where did you dig up those numbers...
整整一万一千块的差额。
Eleven thousand dollars... in discrepancy...
先生，客人们出手阔绰……有些打赏也是有的……
Sir, the clientele is generous... there are tips, you see...
这照片上写着“花瓶四千”、“油画七千”——
The photo reads 'vase four thousand,' 'painting seven thousand' --
正好填平一万一千块的差额！这就是色情勒索交易的账，对吧！
That exactly closes the eleven-thousand-dollar gap! This is your blackmail racket using Vivian, isn't it?!...
这和账上的差额不是一回事！
That has nothing to do with the missing money in the books!
那这笔刚好吻合差额的钱哪来的？
Then where does this money that matches the gap exactly come from?...
是古董！照片背面不是写得清清楚楚吗？那是古董买卖！
It's antiques! Can't you read what's written on the back of those photos? It's antique trading!...
花瓶卖给了Vanderbilt先生，油画卖给了Coleman先生！
The vase was sold to Mr. Vanderbilt, the painting to Mr. Coleman!...
古董买卖？
Antique trading?...
对。Vanderbilt 先生那笔是去年十一月结的。
Yes. The Vanderbilt deal closed last November.
Coleman 先生那笔，今年开春也完事了。
The Coleman deal was settled this spring...
早就交割清楚了。这一万多块，就是那些古董的进项。
All settled and done. That eleven thousand... is just the revenue from those antiques...
交割清楚了？
All settled and done?...
都有交割的条子可查，先生。我没骗您。
There are transaction records you can check, sir. I'm not lying to you...
花瓶和油画，这两样真家伙早就卖出去了，眼下根本不在酒吧里。
The vase and the painting... those genuine articles were sold off long ago. They're not in the bar anymore...
卖出去了？这批古董今晚还在酒吧里，连地方都没动过。
Sold off? These antiques are still in the bar tonight. Haven't even been moved...
这幅你嘴里“卖给 Coleman”的油画，
This painting you claim was 'sold to Coleman' --
今晚还端端正正地挂在歌舞厅的墙上。
...is still hanging right there on the dance hall wall tonight...
画工粗糙得连外行都骗不过，画框底下还明明白白贴着Coleman的名字。
The brushwork is so crude it wouldn't fool an amateur... and Coleman's name is still right there on the frame...
这……这兴许是个用来装点门面的赝品仿制……
That... that might just be a replica... for decoration...
那这照片呢？今晚陈列柜上的花瓶，和以前一模一样。
And this photograph? The vase on the display cabinet tonight... looks exactly the same as before...
你说的“卖出去了”，是卖给了哪位幽灵？
When you said 'sold off'... which ghost did you sell them to?...
现场……您连这都拍下来了。
The scene... you even photographed that...
现在，古董这套说辞也编不下去了。账本里那一万一，到底是什么脏钱？
Now your antique story has fallen apart too. That eleven thousand in the ledger... what kind of dirty money is it really?...
……好。我说。
...Fine. I'll talk...
那我就洗耳恭听这酒吧里的秘密了。
Then I'm all ears... for the Blue Moon's secrets...
Brennan先生！
Mr. Brennan!...
我问完回来了，Morrison那边怎么说？
I'm back from my rounds. What did Morrison have to say?...
Morrison刚把 Gray 小姐和 Rosa 审问了一遍，
Morrison just finished questioning Miss Gray and Rosa--...
因为没定论又把她们放回房间了。
He couldn't reach a conclusion, so he sent them both back to their rooms...
Gray 小姐的状态很奇怪，她好像连自己有没有杀害 Webb 都不确定。
Miss Gray's state is... strange. She doesn't even seem sure whether she actually killed Webb or not...
我刚才也去向 Tommy 确认了我们找到的那张照片。
I went and confirmed that photograph we found with Tommy...
那不是 Gray 的私密照片，而是用来勒索其他人的把柄。
It wasn't Gray's private photograph. It was leverage -- material for blackmailing someone else...
勒索别人的把柄？也就是说，那个藏在暗处的房间，
Leverage for blackmailing others? So that hidden room--...
其实是 Webb 专门存放勒索材料的地方？
...was actually Webb's personal storage for blackmail material?...
没错。
That's right...
那个专门用来勒索的小房间，再想想Gray 小姐现在的处境……
A room dedicated to blackmail... and when you think about Miss Gray's situation now...
她有充分的动机。
She had every reason to want him dead...
加上Rosa 一口咬定，枪响的时候，
And Rosa insists that when the gunshot went off--...
房间里只有Gray小姐一个人，还拿着枪。
Miss Gray was the only one in the room, and she was holding a gun...
就算 Gray 小姐自己不确定，她也很可能会被当成真凶。
Even if Miss Gray herself isn't sure, she'll likely be pegged as the killer...

Parameters.ParameterStr: Rosa 的证言，可能有点问题。
Parameters.ParameterEn: Something may be wrong with Rosa's testimony.

Parameters.ParameterStr: Rosa 只是个清洁工，她为什么一开始要撒谎？
Parameters.ParameterEn: Rosa's just a cleaning woman. Why did she lie in the first place?

Words: 就算 Gray 真的是凶手，但她手里那把枪根本没开过火，
Even if Gray really is the killer, the gun in her hand was never fired--...
而 Rosa 却信誓旦旦地说一定是她杀了Webb。
...yet Rosa swore up and down that Gray absolutely killed Webb...
所以 Rosa 所谓的"完美目击"，其实有很多破绽。
So Rosa's so-called 'perfect eyewitness account' actually has a lot of holes in it...
对。她把时间卡得太死，简直就像是背好的一样。我们需要去找她聊聊。
Right. Her timeline was too precise -- like she'd rehearsed it. We need to go have a talk with her...
Rosa只是一个清洁工，她看上去像是那种不想惹麻烦的人，
Rosa's just a cleaning lady. She seems like the type who doesn't want trouble--...
为什么要冒着作伪证的风险，咬死是Gray杀的人？
...so why would she risk perjury to pin this on Gray?...
你是觉得，Rosa指认Vivian的动机不纯？
You think Rosa's motive for pointing at Vivian isn't clean?...
Gray 也许开了枪，也许没开，但 Rosa 这边一定藏着什么秘密。
Gray may or may not have pulled the trigger. But Rosa -- she's definitely hiding something...
还是你思路清晰！不过，既然案情这么扑朔迷离，
Sharp as always! But with the case this tangled--...
我还以为明天准备写的头版要开天窗了。
I was starting to worry my front page tomorrow would be a blank...
所以，你明天的头版标题想好是什么了吗？
So, have you figured out your front-page headline yet?...
还在思考……说实话，这是我作为新人记者第一次申请到报纸的头版。
Still working on it... To be honest, this is the first time I've ever landed a front page as a new reporter...
如果这个案子没能比那些好莱坞影星的婚姻轶事更吸睛，为了见报，我可能……
If this case can't compete with Hollywood starlets' marriage scandals for eyeballs, I might have to...
不得不牺牲一些真实性。
...sacrifice some of the truth...
比如，直接写个轰动的“当红歌女身陷风月交易，竟一枪毙了自家老板”。
Something lurid, like, 'Popular Songbird Caught in Vice Ring—Guns Down Her Own Boss.'
……倒也没到那种程度。
...It wouldn't be that bad...
我记得一开始，你是说你来这里是为了追求真相的。
If I recall, you told me you came here to pursue the truth...
我……我确实更想追求真相。
I... I do want to pursue the truth...

Parameters.ParameterStr: 那就一起来把藏起来的事实挖出来。
Parameters.ParameterEn: Then let's dig out the truth they've buried.

Parameters.ParameterStr: 相信我，真正的真相不会让你的主编失望。
Parameters.ParameterEn: Trust me, the real truth won't disappoint your editor.

Words: 那就一起来把藏起来的事实挖出来。它肯定不会让你的主编失望。
Then let's dig out the truth they've buried together. Trust me -- it won't disappoint your editor...
也是。只有揭开那层黑暗，
You're right. Only by pulling back that curtain of darkness--...
这篇报道才会是我——Emma O'Malley的报道。
...will this story truly be mine -- Emma O'Malley's story...
相信我，只要我们能拼凑出现场真正的拼图，
Trust me -- if we can piece together the real puzzle of what happened at that scene--...
那个真相绝对比编造的故事更有分量。
...that truth will carry far more weight than any made-up story...
借你吉言，Brennan 先生。我们得抓紧了。
I'll hold you to that, Mr. Brennan. Let's get moving...
等会进去看看 Gray 小姐肯不肯回答几个问题——至少先把最基本的事实弄清楚。
We'll see whether Miss Gray is willing to answer a few questions—at least enough to establish the basic facts.
那Rosa和Morrison他们呢？
What about Rosa and Morrison?...
他们就交给我去问一遍。
Leave them to me...
咳……这烟味，可不像在炖汤。
Ahem... that smoke doesn't smell like stew...
啊——Brennan 先生。您怎么……来后厨了？
Ah -- Mr. Brennan. How did you... get back here...
你在烧什么？
What are you burning...
废纸，Brennan 先生，没用的废纸。
Scrap paper, Mr. Brennan. Just... useless scrap paper...
这个点，在厨房烧纸？
Burning paper in the kitchen... at this hour...
前面让我拿来烧的——我只管烧，烧完跟厨余一起倒掉，就这么回事。
The front told me to burn them -- I just burn what they give me, toss it with the kitchen waste, that's all there is to it...
看来你今天的毁尸灭迹工作不太走运。
Looks like your evidence-disposal shift isn't going so well tonight...
……艾斯弗德狂想，爵士风暴，这是……演出节目单？
...Ashford Rhapsody, Jazz Storm -- this is... a show program...
还是今晚的，怎么全烧掉了？
Tonight's program, too. Why burn them all...
……领班说这版印错了，不能用。就这点事。
...The floor manager said this batch was misprinted. Couldn't use them. That's all...
原来如此。
I see...
我只是个在后厨干活的，Brennan 先生。
I'm just a guy who works the back kitchen, Mr. Brennan...
前面安排演什么，印错什么，我一概不管，只管把送进来的东西烧掉。
Whatever shows they put on up front, whatever misprints they make -- none of my business. I just burn what gets sent in...
那楼下的暗账呢？比如 Gray 被推进包厢去陪那些有头有脸的人。
What about the dirty books downstairs? Like Gray being shoved into private rooms to keep those big shots company...
你在这儿待了这么久，一点风都没透上来？
You've been here long enough. Not a single word ever drifted up to you...
……我不大清楚，先生。油烟声太大了，下面发生什么我都听不见。
...I wouldn't really know, sir. The kitchen vent's too loud -- can't hear a thing from downstairs...
不过，Gray小姐……她也是被人推着往前走的。
But Miss Gray... she was pushed into it too...
如果有的选，谁愿意去干那种事呢？
If she had a choice... who'd want to do that kind of thing...
都是为了在这座城市里活下去。谁都不容易。
We're all just trying to survive in this city. Nobody has it easy...
我只是个有家要养的人，先生。楼下那摊浑水……
I'm just a man with a family to feed, sir. That mess downstairs...
谁踩进去，谁就出不来了。大人物的事，我不懂，也不想掺和。
Anyone who steps into it never gets out. Big men's business -- I don't understand it, and I don't want any part of it...
你倒是把自己摘得很干净。
You sure know how to keep your hands clean...
都是老生常谈了，先生。您慢走。
Same old story, sir. You take care now...
Brennan。好，你来得正好，省得我找人传话。
Brennan. Good, you're here -- saves me the trouble of sending someone to fetch you...
勘验完了。腿酸——这地板硬得要命，跪了大半个钟头。
Examination's done. Legs are killing me -- that floor's hard as a coffin lid, been kneeling on it for half an hour...
发现什么——简单说。
What'd you find -- keep it short...
会客室不大。我只查了两处：尸体周围，还有那扇窗。你问吧。
The parlor is small. I checked two places: around the body and around that window. Ask away.
现场就 Webb 的尸体那一块，还有窗那边——这两个地方值得看。
Two spots worth looking at -- around Webb's body, and over by the window...
你等我说完。
Hold on, let me finish...
说吧，你要问哪块？
Go on then, what do you want to know?...

Parameters.ParameterStr: 子弹从哪飞过来的——弹道怎么走的？
Parameters.ParameterEn: Where did the bullet come from--what was its trajectory?

Parameters.ParameterStr: 发现什么异常？弹壳找到了吗？
Parameters.ParameterEn: Anything unusual? Did you find the shell casing?

Parameters.ParameterStr: 案发现场的那个女歌手和清洁工，你怎么看？
Parameters.ParameterEn: What do you make of the singer and the cleaning woman at the crime scene?
No more questions.

Words: 发现什么异常？弹壳找到了吗？
Anything unusual? Did you find the shell casing...
没找到第二把枪。
No second gun.
弹壳也没有。半自动手枪开火总得抛壳，这点躲不过去。
No casing either. A semiautomatic has to eject one when it fires. There is no getting around that.
子弹虽然从窗户上打出去了，但弹壳总会弹出来，这个你懂。
Bullet went through the window, sure, but the casing always ejects -- you know how that works...
我掀了地毯、查了地板缝，助理又复查一遍——还是他妈的空。
I lifted the carpet, checked the floorboards, and had my deputy go over it again. Still goddamn empty.
一颗都没有。那子弹打出去了，弹壳却不在现场.
Not a single one. Bullet went out the window, but the casing's not at the scene...
我自己搜了两遍，让助理又摸了一圈，还是没有。
Searched it twice myself. Had my deputy go over it one more time. Still nothing...
我也懒得编——缺了就是缺了，现场就这样，你记下来吧。
I'm not gonna make something up -- it's missing, that's all there is to it. Write it down...
总结一下：酒吧搜过了，没有其他枪，弹壳也找不到。就这两条。
To sum it up -- searched the whole bar, no other guns, no shell casing. Those are your two takeaways...
子弹从哪飞过来的——弹道怎么走的？
Where'd the bullet come from -- what's the trajectory...
平射。子弹穿过Webb胸口，继续朝窗户走。
Level shot. The bullet passed through Webb’s chest and kept going toward the window.
窗上是出射痕；子弹飞到外面去了。
The window shows an exit strike. The bullet went outside.
射击方向这样——量了两遍，数字没问题。
Trajectory goes like so -- measured it twice, numbers check out...
这种弹道路径不算常见，按道理来说会有弹壳留下的。
That kind of trajectory's not common. Normally you'd expect a casing left behind...
我这辈子量弹道量了一百多次，这条没问题。腰酸是腰酸，数字我不会记错。
I've measured trajectories over a hundred times in my career. This one's clean. Back's sore, sure, but I don't get my numbers wrong...
结论就一句：子弹穿过Webb，击中会客室窗户后飞了出去。
One-line conclusion: the bullet passed through Webb, struck the parlor window, and went outside.
击中了会客室的窗户，射到外面去了。
Hit the parlor window, went clean out the other side...
案发现场的那个女歌手和清洁工，你怎么看？
The singer and the cleaning lady at the crime scene -- what's your read on them...
还能怎么看？一个自己都不确定有没有开枪的疯女人，
What's there to read? One's a crazy dame who can't even say for sure whether she pulled the trigger--
加上一个满嘴流利证词的清洁工。
And a cleaning lady with a real smooth story all ready to go...
反正人证有了，嫌疑人也没否认。
Anyway, we got a witness, and the suspect hasn't denied it...
等我这报告一交，这案子就算是结了。多省事。
Once I file my report, this case is done and dusted. Nice and easy...
要不是某个Webb委托的侦探说要查案，我早就结案回警局去了。
If it weren't for a certain private detective Webb hired insisting on an investigation, I'd have closed this and been back at the precinct already...
行了，我这边算交代清楚了。你有什么要记的都记完没有？
Alright, I've said my piece. You got everything you need written down...
差不多了。
More or less...
哦对——别在里头待太久。现场基本查完了，里面没什么好找的了。
Oh, one more thing -- don't spend too long in there. Scene's been cleared, nothing left to find...
明天还要写报告……这薪水真是一点都不值。
Still gotta write the report tomorrow... this paycheck really isn't worth the trouble...
先、先生……怎么又是您……
S-sir... you again...
我再问你几个事。
I have a few more questions for you...
我已经说过了……该说的我都告诉警察了。
I already said everything... I told the police everything I know...
您再问……再问几遍，也是一样的，先生。
You can ask... ask as many times as you want, it'll be the same answer, sir...

Parameters.ParameterStr: 厨房走廊那张照片，是你掉的？
Parameters.ParameterEn: Did you drop that photograph in the kitchen corridor?

Parameters.ParameterStr: 昨晚 23:00 到 23:30 之间，你在做什么？
Parameters.ParameterEn: What were you doing between 23:00 and 23:30 last night?
No more questions.

Words: 走廊！我……我一直在走廊。就、就是会客室外头那条……
The hallway! I... I was in the hallway the whole time. You know, the one outside the parlor...
我哪儿也没去，一直在打扫！
I didn't go anywhere, I was cleaning the whole time!...
一直在那边打扫？没有离开过？
Cleaning the whole time? Didn't leave once?...
呃……我、我去倒过一次垃圾。大概……23:20。就去了外头的侧巷……
Uh... I... I did take out the trash once. Around... 23:20. Went out to the side alley...
就一会儿！我发誓就一小会儿！
Just for a moment! I swear, just a moment!...
我放下垃圾袋就往回跑了……真的马上就回来了，先生！
I set the trash bag down and ran right back... I really came back right away, sir!...
23:20……就那一次！倒完我一步都没多走，直接就回走廊了！
23:20... just that once! After I dumped the trash I didn't take a single extra step, went straight back to the hallway!...
然后……23:30，我听见枪响了，就去了会客室。
Then... at 23:30, I heard the gunshot, so I went to the parlor...
那时候，Webb 先生的会客室里只有 Gray 小姐在里面。
At that time, only Miss Gray was inside Mr. Webb's parlor...
只有她一个人！绝对只有她！
Only her! Absolutely only her!...
知道了。先等着。
All right. Sit tight...
先生……没别的事了吧？就是这些了吧？
Sir... there's nothing else, is there? That's all, right?...
有事的话，我就会叫你。
If I need anything, I will call for you.
厨房那边的走廊，我捡到了一张照片。这是你掉的吧？
I found a photograph in the corridor by the kitchen. You dropped it, didn't you?
我……Morrison 先生问完话以后，我走得太急了。我以为它还在身上……
I... After Mr. Morrison finished questioning me, I left in such a hurry. I thought I still had it...
看来是你的，拿着吧。
So it is yours. Here.
谢谢您……真的谢谢您。
Thank you... truly, thank you.
照片上的女孩是谁？
Who is the girl in the photograph?
她……她和案子没有关系。求您了，别问她是谁。
She... she has nothing to do with the case. Please, don't ask who she is.
昨晚 23:00 到 23:30 之间，你在做什么？
Last night, between 23:00 and 23:30 -- what were you doing?...
要是让他知道我把实情告诉了您……
If he finds out I told you the truth...
Isabel 就死定了！算我求求您，千万别说是我说的！
Isabel is dead! I'm begging you, please... don't tell anyone I said anything!...
纸条我拿走了。你的名字不会出现在任何人的供词里，我保证。
I've taken the note. Your name won't appear in anyone's statement. I promise...
其、其实……还有一样东西……
There's... there's actually... one more thing...
这个……案发之后我进了会客室，这东西就在地上。
This... after it happened, I went into the parlor, and this thing was just lying on the floor...
鬼使神差的，我就把它捡起来了……
I don't know what came over me... I just... picked it up...
现场少了一枚弹壳。你为什么要把它藏起来？
A shell casing was missing from the scene. Why did you hide it?...
我们这种人，光靠一张嘴谁信呢？总得捏着点能保命的东西。
People like us... who's going to believe just our word? You have to hold onto something that might keep you alive...
可是……警察那里我已经撒了谎，这东西留在我手里，现在就像个催命符……
But... I already lied to the police, and now this thing in my hands... it's like a death sentence...
您拿去吧……我真的不敢再藏着了……
Take it... please... I really can't keep hiding it anymore...
愿上帝保佑您……谢谢您，先生，谢谢您……
God bless you... thank you, sir... thank you...
弹壳我带走了。剩下的事，交给我。
I've got the casing. Leave the rest to me...
Morrison 刚审了你整整一个小时，你还在补妆？
Morrison questioned you for a full hour, and you're still touching up your makeup?
我想把妆补好。
I want to finish it.
只唱一首。没有观众。
One song. No audience.
今晚没有演出。
There's no show tonight.
我知道。
I know.
那还化妆？
Then why the makeup?
唱给谁？
Who is it for?
等我被带走，就没机会再上台了。
Once they take me away, I won't get another chance to stand on that stage.
我自己。
Myself.
所以你想再唱一次。
So you want to sing one more time.
妆还没画完。你们问吧，我听着。
I'm not done with my makeup. Ask what you need to ask. I'm listening.
先把消息来源摆在桌上。Tommy 已经承认，Webb 在蓝月亮做的是勒索生意。
Let us put the source on the table first. Tommy has admitted that Webb was running a blackmail operation out of the Blue Moon.
他倒终于肯把那本脏账吐干净了。
So he finally decided to spit out the whole filthy account.
他说你负责接近客人，Webb 负责拿他们的秘密收钱。
He says you approached the guests, and Webb collected money from their secrets.
那是 Tommy 的说法。我们想听你的，也要核对你昨晚的时间线。
That is Tommy’s version. We want yours, and we also need to verify your timeline last night.
那就只谈事实。
Then we stick to the facts.

Parameters.ParameterStr: Tommy 说你是 Webb 的诱饵。
Parameters.ParameterEn: Tommy says you were Webb’s bait.

Parameters.ParameterStr: 昨晚你什么时候在台上？
Parameters.ParameterEn: When were you onstage last night?

Parameters.ParameterStr: Webb 把全部遗产留给了你。
Parameters.ParameterEn: Webb left his entire estate to you.
No more questions.

Words: Tommy 说，Webb 把你当成那门勒索生意的诱饵。我要听你的版本——具体是怎么回事？
Tommy says Webb used you as bait in that blackmail operation. I want your version—what exactly happened?
把柄。他手里有我太多的把柄……
Leverage. He had far too much leverage over me...
他会把我推进最里面的包厢，关上门。
He would shove me into the innermost booth and shut the door.
你替他做了多久？
How long did you do that for him?
四年。整整四年。要不要我替你们一天一天数？
Four years. Four whole years. Would you like me to count out every day for you?
四年里，你一次也没想过离开？
In four years, did you never once think of leaving?
离开？他手里攥着我的过去。门开着，我也走不出去。
Leave? He held my past in his fist. The door could be open and I still could not walk out.
四年来，他把我当工具用，连离开的资格都不给。
For four years he used me as a tool and would not even allow me to leave.
我没有地方可以逃。
I had nowhere to run.
这种日子，换作是谁都会崩溃的。
That kind of life... anyone would've broken...
所以我才觉得，哪怕真是我杀了他——他死了，
That's why I think... even if I really did kill him... he's dead now--
我去坐牢，也是我们两个罪有应得。
And I go to prison. We both got what we deserved...
昨晚你什么时候在台上？
When were you onstage last night?
22:00 到 23:00。我在台上。灯亮着，所有人都看得见。
From 22:00 to 23:00. I was onstage. The lights were on, and everyone could see me.
下台以后，你下一次见到 Webb 是什么时候？
After you left the stage, when did you next see Webb?
每晚都这样？
Every night?
每天都一样。钟一响，我就去。后来根本不需要人提醒。
Every night was the same. The moment the clock struck, I went. After a while, no one even had to remind me.
他要检查我有没有照命令办事。
He wanted to check whether I had followed his orders.
像一条规矩长进了身体里。
As if the rule had grown into your body.
别替我形容。
Do not put words around it for me.
那个指认你开枪的清洁工，Rosa，你们之间有过节吗？
The cleaning woman who identified you as the shooter -- Rosa. Any bad blood between you two...
Rosa？我和她……几乎没有说过话。
Rosa? She and I... we've barely ever spoken...
她只是个在地下室干活的清洁工，我们能有什么仇怨？
She's just a cleaning woman working in the basement. What grudge could we possibly have...
也就是说，她没有理由故意栽赃你。
So she'd have no reason to frame you deliberately...

她肯定是看见了什么……所以才指认我的。
这不就证明是我干的吗？
She must have seen something... that's why she pointed to me. Doesn't that just prove I did it...
仔细想想，她平时有什么特别在意的人或事吗？
Think carefully. Is there anything she cares about more than anything else...
Rosa 常躲在厨房下面的楼道里，盯着一张女孩的照片发呆。
Rosa often hides in the corridor below the kitchen and stares at a photograph of a girl.
她不想让别人看见？
She doesn't want anyone to see it?
看上去是。只要有人经过，她就会马上把照片收起来。
It seems that way. Whenever anyone passes, she puts it away at once.
我不知道女孩是谁，也从没问过。
I don't know who the girl is. I never asked.
除此以外，我对她几乎一无所知。
Beyond that, I know almost nothing about her.
明白。再看这个。
Understood. Now look at this.
Webb 把全部遗产留给了你。
Webb left his entire estate to you.
……全部？留给我？
...All of it? He left it to me?
普通老板不会把一切留给一个员工。
An ordinary employer does not leave everything to one employee.
不可能。
Impossible.
哪里不可能？
What part is impossible?
不。不可能。把它收起来。
No. Impossible. Put it away.
然后，我会陪那些体面客人喝酒、说笑，哄他们把不该说的话说出口。
Then I would drink and laugh with those respectable guests, coaxing them into saying things they should never have said.
他把我当工具用了四年。答应过我的事，也能说收回就收回。这样的人怎么会——
He used me as a tool for four years. Any promise he made, he could take back. How could a man like that—
怎么会把一切留给你？
How could he leave everything to you?
一张纸不能把他变成好人。
A piece of paper cannot turn him into a good man.
我们没这么说。
We did not say it could.
可如果他还在意我……那我昨晚做的又算什么？
But if he still cared about me... then what does that make what I did last night?
先生，我已经回答过了……
Sir, I've already answered all of this...
我知道。再说一遍。
I know. Say it again...
23:30！我听见了枪响！就只有那一声！绝对只有一声！
23:30! I heard the gunshot! There was only that one! Absolutely only one!...
那个时候，会客室里只有 Gray 小姐在！除了她没别人！所以只能是她干的！
At that time, only Miss Gray was in the parlor! No one else! So it had to be her!...
你确定你所说的时间点没有丝毫差错？
You're certain the time you stated has no margin of error whatsoever?...
23:30 一定是Webb死亡的枪响。
23:30 -- that was definitely the gunshot that killed Webb...
我亲耳听到，那会儿只有Gray小姐在里面。
I heard it with my own ears -- only Miss Gray was inside at the time...
23:30 那一声不是唯一的枪响——这块玻璃上的硝烟，
The 23:30 shot wasn't the only one -- the gunpowder residue on this piece of glass...
是另一个时间点留下的。
...was left at a different time entirely...
这是……这是窗户的玻璃。
This is... this is glass from the window...
压在你放的垃圾袋正下面。
Right underneath the trash bag you left there...
这……这说明什么？玻璃……玻璃碎了，可能是很久以前的事……
Wh-what... what does that prove? The glass... the glass could've broken a long time ago...
你也是这里的清洁工，应该最清楚不过。走廊外侧巷的垃圾袋，昨晚是谁收的？
You're the janitor here -- you'd know better than anyone. Who took out the trash to the side alley last night?...
是我……但我不知道这玻璃是哪来的！
It was me... but I don't know where that glass came from!...
你既然是晚上 23:20 去倒的垃圾，
Since you took out that trash at 23:20...
如果这玻璃早就碎了，那这硝烟又是从哪颗子弹来的？
...and the glass was already broken long ago -- then where did the gunpowder residue on it come from?...
也许……可能是我……是我记错去丢垃圾的时间了……我脑子太乱了……
Maybe... maybe I... I got the time wrong when I took out the trash... my head's all mixed up...
但我亲眼看见——Gray小姐手里有枪。有枪就是证明，先生。
But I saw it with my own eyes -- Miss Gray had a gun in her hand. A gun is proof, sir...
时间我也许记错了。这我承认……
The time -- maybe I got it wrong. I'll admit that...
但那把枪是真实的。我亲眼看见——Gray小姐手里拿着枪。
But the gun was real. I saw it with my own eyes -- Miss Gray was holding a gun...
先生，有枪不就是证明了吗……
Sir, having a gun -- doesn't that prove it...
求您了，这一点，我不会记错的。
Please, sir -- this one thing, I could not have gotten wrong...
Martinez小姐，什么你都记错了——你不仅在时间上撒谎，
Miss Martinez, you got everything wrong -- you didn't just lie about the time...
连你所谓的“亲眼目睹”也经不起推敲。你为什么一直在说谎？
...even your so-called 'eyewitness account' doesn't hold up. Why do you keep lying?...
我没有说谎！
I'm not lying!
没人逼我，我是自愿来作证的。我就是 Gray 小姐杀人现场真正的目击证人（Witches）！
No one forced me. I came forward to testify of my own free will. I am the true eyewitness to Miss Gray's murder!
自愿？那这张写在餐巾纸上的字条是谁留给你的。
Voluntary? Then who left you this note scrawled on a cocktail napkin...
This...
是谁威胁你的？
Who threatened you?...
没……没有……没人……
N-no... no one... nobody...
你在害怕。你在害怕一旦你说出真相，那个人会对你不利。
You're afraid. You're afraid that once you tell the truth, that person will come after you...
我不能……先生，求您了，别问了。我什么都不知道……
I can't... sir, please, stop asking. I don't know anything...
既然不知道，那你为什么那么听话？纸条里不仅让你去作证。还有什么。
If you don't know anything, then why did you do exactly what the note said? It didn't just tell you to testify. What else was in it...
先生，您根本不知道那些人多可怕……这不关您的事，您别管了……
Sir, you have no idea how terrifying those people are... this isn't your problem, just leave it alone...
是不关我的事。但如果你因为做伪证被关进去，谁来管那个真正被卷进来的人？
It's not my problem. But if you go to prison for perjury, who's going to take care of the person who's really caught up in this?...
对方知道你最怕什么。他们拿什么在要挟你？
They know exactly what you're most afraid of. What are they holding over you?...
您别问了！我求求您了！他们什么都知道，我们这种人拿什么跟他们斗啊！
Stop asking! I'm begging you! They know everything -- people like us, what can we do against them!...
会死人的……真的会死人的！
People will die... people will really die!...
是因为——你的女儿吗？
Is it because of -- your daughter?...
不……不要碰她……
No... don't touch her...
是……是这张纸条……上面说 23:30，让我去会客室……
It was... it was the note... it said 23:30, go to the parlor...
写这张纸条的人让我告诉警察，是我看着 Gray 小姐开的枪……
The person who wrote it told me to tell the police that I watched Miss Gray pull the trigger...
不然，他就会找上 Isabel。
Otherwise... he'd come for Isabel...
她才十岁，还在生病……给她治病的 Miller 基金说，
She's only ten... she's still sick... the Miller Foundation said...
等她病好了，还可以继续资助她上学……我怎么敢拿她的命赌？
...once she gets better, they'd keep sponsoring her schooling... how could I gamble with her life?...
对方甚至能知道你女儿的医院在哪？
They even know which hospital your daughter's at?...
是！他什么都知道！连 Gray 小姐每天那么固定的送酒时间他都清清楚楚！
Yes! He knows everything! He even knew Miss Gray's exact drink delivery time down to the minute!...
要不是酒吧里的人，谁能算计得这么准……
If it wasn't someone from the bar, who could've planned it that precisely...
所以你就能乖乖听话，把罪名推给别人？
So you just did as you were told and pinned it on someone else?...
先生，我知道我对不起 Gray 小姐，可那个混蛋简直是个魔鬼！
Sir, I know what I did to Miss Gray was wrong, but that bastard -- he's a devil!...
看你的表情，已经拿到了一些关键证据？
Judging by the look on your face... you've got something solid?...
嗯。Rosa 撒了谎，那张威胁她做伪证的纸条，我也拿到了。
Yeah. Rosa lied. And I've got the note -- the one they used to threaten her into giving false testimony...
没错。而且，就算我们拿着证据向 Morrison 证明 Gray 没开枪，
Exactly. And even if we did prove to Morrison that Gray didn't pull the trigger--...
真凶呢？
What about the real killer?...
猜到了。她昨天那副样子，像是早就替自己选好了结局。
I guessed as much. The way she looked yesterday, it was as though she had already chosen how this would end for her.
拜托。她昨天那副态度，摆明了不想让任何人靠近。现在又认了罪——
Come on. Yesterday she made it clear she wanted no one near her. Now she has confessed—
委托人死了，继承人一心往牢里钻。再查下去，真相未必找得到，尾款倒肯定先打水漂。
The client is dead, and the heir is determined to land in jail. We may not find the truth, but the final payment is already sinking.
记者的请求有调查经费吗？
Does a reporter's request come with an investigation budget?
Webb 把所有财产留给她，她却宁愿认罪。这两件事之间还藏着什么。先查清口供是怎么录的，再去问她。
Webb left her everything, yet she would rather confess. Something is still hidden between those two facts. First we find out how the confession was taken; then we ask her.
女人说话，你得学会听重点。
When a woman speaks, you need to learn which words matter.
那你不准备直接去找 Morrison 证明 Rosa 做了伪证，
So why not go straight to Morrison and prove Rosa gave false testimony--...
Gray 小姐无罪吗？
--and prove Miss Gray is innocent?...
没那么简单。Rosa 是被逼的。
It's not that simple. Rosa was forced into it...
她有个重病的女儿，靠 Miller 基金资助才保住性命，
She has a daughter -- seriously ill. The only thing keeping that child alive is a grant from the Miller Foundation...
那个真凶拿孩子的命威胁她。
The real killer threatened Rosa with her daughter's life...
Miller 家族基金……他们有严格的收入审查，不是谁想申请就能申请的。
The Miller Family Foundation... they have strict income assessments. You can't just apply...
……我也是靠着Miller的资助才读完了书。
...I was on a Miller grant myself. It's the only reason I finished school...
Rosa 一个酒吧清洁工，带着生病的孩子……她有多难，可以想象。
Rosa -- a bar janitor, raising a sick child alone... you can imagine how hard that is...
她赶的不是调查，是同情。越急着把人推开，越说明她怕有人真的留下。
She was not pushing away the investigation. She was pushing away sympathy. The harder she drives people off, the more she fears someone might stay.
她不相信我们真的会帮她，不代表她不需要真相。我不能凭一份没核实的口供，就把她写成杀人犯。
She doesn't believe we'll really help her. That doesn't mean she doesn't need the truth. I can't turn an unverified confession into a murder story.
没有。不过只要证明她不是凶手，她就还能继承遗产，你也还有机会拿到尾款。
No. But if you prove she is not the killer, she can still inherit the estate—and you may still collect the balance.
终于说了句能让私家侦探振作的话。
Now that is the sort of thing that perks up a private detective.
不过你的报道可以先空出一行——Vivian 不可能杀死 Webb。
But you can leave a line blank in your story already—Vivian could not have killed Webb.
现场的碎片证明，真正的枪响早于 23:20。
The fragments at the scene prove that the real gunshot came before 23:20.
等等……你什么时候把这些全部想明白的？
Wait... when did you work all of that out?
Vivian 是 23:30 才进入 Webb 的包厢。那时候，Webb 早就死了。
Vivian did not enter Webb's parlor until 23:30. By then, Webb was already dead.
所以我们之前问错了问题。不是她怎么杀了 Webb，而是她为什么要认下一桩自己不可能完成的罪。
Then we have been asking the wrong question. Not how she killed Webb, but why she confessed to a crime she could not have committed.
那我去走廊找找当时在场的人。Gray 小姐不喜欢记者式的问话，我在场只会让她更加防备。
I will check the corridor and find whoever was there. Miss Gray dislikes a reporter's line of questioning; having me there would only put her more on guard.
她第三次赶我们出去以前。我算的是这桩委托还能不能做成，不是这案子能不能破。
Before the third time she told us to get out. I was calculating whether this job could still be completed, not whether I could solve the case.
我很同情她。但即便如此……作伪证这件事情，依然需要得到公正的判断。
I feel for her. Truly. But even so... perjury still needs to face a just reckoning...
我们不能因为同情就隐瞒真相。
We can't hide the truth just because we feel sorry for her...

Parameters.ParameterStr: 公正的代价如果是一条命呢？
Parameters.ParameterEn: What if the price of justice is a life?

Parameters.ParameterStr: 现在的艾斯弗德，你能指望谁来给她公正？
Parameters.ParameterEn: In Ashford today, who can you trust to give her justice?

Words: 那张纸条一旦交上去，Rosa 就会变成那帮家伙眼里的弃子。
The moment that note gets turned in, Rosa becomes a loose end in their eyes...
你比我更清楚，他们会对这种没权没势的母亲做什么。
You know better than I do what they'd do to a mother like that -- no money, no connections...
所以你是在权衡……
So you're weighing it all......
把她交给 Morrison，大陪审团也许能给出公正的判决。
Hand her over to Morrison, and maybe a grand jury gives her a fair shake...
但那些用枪指着她的黑帮呢？在他们眼里，她可没有上法庭的机会。
But the mob pointing guns at her? In their eyes, she doesn't get a day in court...
你的意思是，现在交出证据反而是害了她。
You're saying... turning in the evidence right now would actually put her in danger...
祝你好运，大侦探。
Good luck, Mr. Detective.
希望熟客能比上次多拿两分钟。
Let us hope a returning customer gets two more minutes than last time.
那个熟悉这里一切的人还藏在暗处。
Whoever it is -- someone who knows this place inside and out -- they're still hiding in the shadows...
只要他不落网，Gray 就算脱罪了也依然是活靶子。
As long as they're free, Gray's a walking target -- even if she beats the charges...
我们得让 Gray 明白这一点，配合我们把真凶找出来。
We need Gray to understand that. Get her to cooperate -- help us find the real killer...
她恐怕不会配合了，Brennan 先生。因为就在刚才……
She's... not likely to cooperate, Mr. Brennan. Because just now--...
Gray 小姐自愿向 Morrison 认罪了。
Miss Gray voluntarily confessed to Morrison...
Brennan？你可算来了。这案子简直是见鬼了！
Brennan? About damn time you showed up. This case is a goddamn circus!
听说 Gray 小姐来找你认罪了。你是不是觉得可以直接结案了？
I heard Miss Gray came in to confess. You ready to close the case?
结案？那也叫认罪？漏洞百出，连她自己是怎么开枪的都说不清楚。
Close the case? You call that a confession? Full of holes -- she can't even explain how she pulled the trigger.
一看就是脑子不清醒跑来顶罪的。
Obviously wasn't thinking straight when she waltzed in to take the fall.
更麻烦的是，那个清洁工 Rosa，刚才居然也跑来撤销了她的目击证言！
And to make matters worse, that cleaning lady Rosa just came in and retracted her eyewitness testimony!
全乱套了！
The whole thing's gone to hell!
既然看出来口供有问题，你打算怎么办？
Since you can see the confession doesn't hold up, what's your plan?
还能怎么办？这报告根本没法写！这不明摆着给我找麻烦吗。
What can I do? I can't write a report with this mess! She's just making my job harder on purpose.
听着，你得想办法让 Vivian 撤销她那份见鬼的认罪供词。
Look, you need to find a way to get Vivian to withdraw that damn confession.
只有这样，我才能把这烂摊子丢给局里其他同事重新查！
That's the only way I can dump this mess on someone else at the precinct to re-investigate!

Parameters.ParameterStr: 现在这种证人临时撤销证言的事多吗？
Parameters.ParameterEn: Is it common for witnesses to suddenly recant these days?
How long have you been sitting here?
No more questions.

Words: 以前不多。伪证罪可是要坐牢的重罪，正常人谁敢拿这开玩笑？
Not often, back in the day. Perjury's a felony that puts you behind bars -- what normal person would mess around with that?
但自从黑帮开始用枪指着证人的脑袋，情况就不一样了。
But ever since the gangs started putting guns to witnesses' heads, things changed.
是啊。检方现在哪敢起诉伪证？人都快没命了，撤案反而是最安全的。
Yeah. The DA won't even prosecute perjury anymore. People are nearly getting killed -- dropping charges is actually the safest play now.
毕竟那帮家伙连警察都能收买，谁还指望局里能去起诉他们恐吓证人？
After all, when they can buy cops too, who's going to prosecute them for witness intimidation?
谁说不是呢。Webb 的案子……
Tell me about it. The Webb case...
多半也会像那几百起帮派谋杀一样，不了了之。
...it'll probably end up just like those hundreds of other gang murders. Unsolved. Forgotten.
现在的艾斯弗德，能把人送进监狱的可能只有逃税。谋杀？那得看命。
The way Ashford works now, the only thing that puts people behind bars is tax evasion. Murder? That takes luck.
你调查你的。我不催你结果。七十二小时还有时间。
You do your investigating. I'm not rushing you for results. Seventy-two hours... still got time.
但 Brennan——别找太多麻烦。明白？
But Brennan -- don't go looking for too much trouble. Understand?
多久？谁数着呢。这地方的钟歪的，爵士乐吵的，我带的怀表今天早上停了。
How long? Who's counting? The clock on the wall's crooked, the jazz is deafening, and my pocket watch stopped this morning.
警察在案发现场喝酒，这合规矩吗？
A cop drinking at a crime scene. Is that regulation?
没这玩意儿，我在这见鬼的地方可活不下去。
Without this stuff, I wouldn't survive five minutes in this godforsaken place.
这里的酒不便宜，一杯下去，两天烟草钱没了。
The drinks here aren't cheap either. One glass and there goes two days' worth of tobacco money.
本来我这会儿该在俱乐部里打牌的。真倒霉。
I should've been at the club playing cards right now. Rotten luck.
看来你的夜生活挺丰富。
Sounds like you've got quite the nightlife.
打牌而已。说实话，在俱乐部里打牌还是比去赌马好点。
Just cards. Honestly, playing cards at the club beats going to the racetrack any day.
至少牌桌上的输赢，还能自己盯着。
At least at the card table, you can keep your own eyes on the wins and losses.
看来你对赌马怨念很深。
Sounds like you've got a grudge against the racetrack.
随口一说罢了。
Just making conversation.
说起来，你查到什么没有？
Anyway... you find anything yet?
还在查。
Still working on it.
行了，Brennan。去做你的事。我在这儿。哪也不去。
All right, Brennan. Go do your thing. I'll be right here. Not going anywhere.
有结果我会来找你。
I'll come find you when I have something.
我知道。
I know.
Morrison。
Morrison.
Brennan。还有我们的大记者，O'Malley 小姐。
Brennan. And our very own star reporter, Miss O'Malley.
你们俩这形影不离的，看来今晚的调查收获颇丰啊。
You two are practically joined at the hip. Must've been quite the productive evening.
怎么样，《先驱报》那篇惊天动地的报道，写得还顺利吗？
So, how's that earth-shattering scoop for the Herald coming along?
放心吧，探长。这篇报道一定会详细记录您在这个案子里的‘精彩表现’。
Don't worry, Detective. The article will document your 'stellar performance' on this case in great detail.
绝对不会让您失望的。
You absolutely won't be disappointed.
那我可得好好期待一下了。
Well, I'll be looking forward to it then.
Vivian 刚来撤回口供，我就知道你们会跟过来。
As soon as Vivian came in to withdraw her confession, I knew you two would follow.
说吧，你们又查到了什么？我也好看看，这烫手山芋该往哪儿放。
Go on, then. What else have you found? I need to know where this particular hot potato belongs.
案子没结束。真正开枪的人另有其人。你看这个——会客室里找到的。
The case is not over. Someone else fired the shot. Look at this—from the parlor.
Rosa 交来的案发现场弹壳。拓印确认是 .45 ACP；Vivian 的枪是 .25，而且没有近期击发痕迹。
The casing Rosa handed over from the scene. Its impression confirms .45 ACP; Vivian's pistol is a .25 and shows no sign of recent firing.
警用弹壳？……你能确定，这玩意儿就是杀死Webb的那颗子弹留下的吗？
A police-issue casing...? You're sure this thing is from the bullet that killed Webb?
案发现场出现警用弹壳，这可不是什么小事。
A police-issue casing at the crime scene is no small matter.
探长，您最好把它妥善收进证物袋。
Detective, you'd better bag that properly as evidence.
……那是自然。
...Of course.
来，先把这子弹给我，我得收进证物袋里。
Here, hand that casing over. I need to bag it as evidence.
收好。
Here.
对了，Webb雇过你。把那份委托合同也给我。
One more thing. Webb retained you. Give me the commission contract.
你要看那个干什么？
What do you need that for?
转交报告得写清你的身份。别紧张，只是拍一张照。
The transfer report has to state your role. Relax—I'm only taking a photograph.
这是流程，Brennan。把原件给我吧。
It's procedure, Brennan. Give me the original.
小心点，这是原本。
Careful. That's the original.
现在，没人能拿这张废纸妨碍办案了。
Now nobody can use that scrap of paper to interfere with my case.
你他妈在干什么！
What the hell are you doing!
我在办案。至于这枚弹壳，它根本就不是杀害 Webb 的那颗子弹留下的。
I'm doing my job. As for that casing — it has nothing to do with the bullet that killed Webb.
谁知道是不是你从哪捡来妨碍公务的。
For all I know, you picked it up somewhere just to obstruct justice.
Vivian 有动机，持枪出现在尸体旁，还认了罪。她当然是嫌疑人。
Vivian had motive, was found armed beside the body, and confessed. Of course she's a suspect.
这些理由已经写进卷宗。
Those grounds are already in the file.
你刚毁了证据，现在还想去抓 Vivian？
You just destroyed evidence, and now you want to arrest Vivian?
她已经撤回口供，那枚弹壳也证明她没开枪。你没有理由带走她。
She retracted her confession, and that casing proves she did not fire. You have no grounds to take her.
理由我已经写进卷宗了。Brennan，别挡路。
I've already put the reason in the case file. Don't stand in my way, Brennan.
把 Vivian 带进来。
Bring Vivian in.
我已经撤回认罪了。我的枪也没有开过。
I withdrew my confession. My gun was never fired.
她的枪没有近期击发痕迹，口径也对不上。你不能装作没看见。
Her pistol shows no recent firing, and the caliber does not match. You cannot pretend otherwise.
口径问题我会让法医重查。在结果出来以前，她仍然是嫌疑人。
I will have the coroner recheck the caliber. Until the result comes back, she remains a suspect.
等一下。证据链根本没闭合——你只是急着结案。
Hold it. The evidence doesn't add up—you just want this case closed.
退后。
Step back.
你要是敢开枪，就得当着所有艾斯弗德先驱报读者的面，解释为什么了。
If you fire that gun, you'll have to explain why to every reader of the Ashford Herald.
你们的话说完了？
Are you finished?
我没打算开枪。法庭上，我会解释这枚弹壳为什么不可信。
I have no intention of firing. In court, I will explain why that casing cannot be trusted.
够了。走。
Enough. Move.
不。我不认罪。
No. I am not confessing.
以前我以为真相根本不值钱。现在至少还有人肯为了它惹麻烦。
I used to think the truth was worth nothing. Now at least someone is willing to make trouble for it.
我不会再替别人认罪。
I will not confess for someone else again.
看来……我只能先去警局待一会儿了，是吗？
It seems... I'll have to spend a little time at the station first, won't I?
这些话留到法庭上说。
Save that for the court.
我已经等了四年，不在乎再等几天。
I have already waited four years. A few more days will not matter.
但别让我再白等一次。
But do not make me wait for nothing again.
不会。
We will not.
Brennan 先生。我听 Morrison 说，Gray 小姐去认罪了？
Mr. Brennan. I heard from Morrison that... Miss Gray went and confessed?
怎么？她替别人顶罪，正合了你们这些想明哲保身的人的意吧。
What, surprised? She's taking the fall for someone else... must be convenient for all you people trying to keep your heads down.
少拿 Gray 小姐来试探我，Brennan。该回答的我会回答，但别指望我替任何人表态。
Do not use Miss Gray to test me, Brennan. I will answer what I can, but do not expect me to declare myself for anyone.
那我们就来聊聊Webb的事。
Then let's talk about Webb.
没错。
That's right.

Parameters.ParameterStr: Webb 好像一直在一笔叫“鲸鱼”（Whale）的账上栽跟头。
Parameters.ParameterEn: Webb kept running into trouble over an account called Whale.

Parameters.ParameterStr: 看看这枚案发现场的弹壳。是不是让你想起了点旧伤？
Parameters.ParameterEn: Look at this casing from the crime scene. Does it bring back an old wound?
No more questions.

Words: Webb 好像一直在一个叫 Whale 的人身上栽跟头。
Webb kept tripping over someone called Whale.
你看他的字迹，写这名字的时候手都在抖。
Look at his handwriting here. His hand was shaking when he wrote this name.
……是他的字迹。
...That's his handwriting, all right.
这种大人物，总不能是坐在家里等收账吧。
A man like that doesn't just sit at home waiting for the money to roll in.
酒吧里来来往往这么多人，总得有双眼睛替他盯着这笔投资。
All those people coming and going through this bar... someone's got to be keeping an eye on his investment.
眼睛是有。不过，那些自以为掩饰得很好的眼睛，其实很明显。
There are eyes, sure enough. But the ones who think they're being subtle... they're usually the most obvious.
比如？
Such as?
比如最近常来找Webb先生的那位 Rita 小姐。
Such as that Miss Rita who's been coming around to see Mr. Webb lately.
她点马提尼，却从来不碰杯口。
She orders a martini every time... but never touches the rim of the glass.
反而总是盯着我们会客室那条走廊。
Instead, her eyes are always on the corridor leading to our meeting room.
每当 Webb 先生见完那些大主顾，她总会借故和他们攀谈，打听点什么东西。
Every time Mr. Webb finished meeting one of his big clients, she'd find some excuse to chat them up... fishing for something.
我干了这么多年，有些人的心思，不用问我也能看出来。
I've been doing this long enough. Some people's intentions... you don't need to ask to see them.
原来 Whale 的耳目早就坐在你们眼皮子底下了。
So Whale's eyes and ears have been sitting right under your noses this whole time.
那女人的动作不像普通客人。她一直替某个人盯着会客室。
That woman did not behave like an ordinary guest. She was watching the parlor for someone.
如果她真是 Whale 的耳目，这案子就不是酒吧里的人自己能收拾的。
If she truly works for Whale, this is not something anyone inside the club can contain.
事实我说完了。别再问我站在哪一边。
Those are the facts. Do not ask me whose side I am on.
别拿“算账”糊弄我。Webb 后来找的接班人，是不是也替他跑这些脏活？
Do not hide behind "doing the books." Did Webb's successor run the same dirty errands for him?
跑腿的活儿，酒吧里不少人都碰过。真正的脏活，只交给身份不干净的人。
Plenty of people in the club ran ordinary errands. The truly dirty work went only to people with questionable papers.
因为他们需要 Webb 手里的合法身份。
Because they needed the legal identities Webb could provide.
对。我以前也是其中一个。
Yes. I used to be one of them.
我知道那摊脏活有多深，也知道拿到那张纸以后，人会有多怕失去它。
I know how deep that filth runs, and how afraid a person becomes of losing those papers once they have them.
后来接手的人，就是 Webb 新拴住的那条线。
Whoever took over after me was simply the next person Webb put on a leash.
那个人是谁？
Who was it?
我不知道名字。Webb 不会把所有线都交给一个账房。
I don't know the name. Webb would never place every line in the hands of one bookkeeper.
但你能确定，真有这么一个接班人。
But you are certain there really was a successor.
确定。Webb 手里的合法身份，就是拴人的绳子。去找那个最怕失去那张纸的人。
I am. The legal identities in Webb's hands were leashes. Find the person most afraid of losing those papers.
这已经是我能说的全部。
That is everything I can tell you.
行，我会查。
All right. I'll look into it.
看看这枚案发现场的弹壳。是不是让你想起了点旧伤？
Take a look at this casing from the crime scene. Does it remind you of an old wound?
……您从哪儿找到这东西的。
...Where did you find that thing.
你之前这儿的弹壳，也是这个口径吧？
The casing that hit you back then... same caliber, right?
.45……这可是时下常用的配枪口径。
.45... that's the standard sidearm caliber these days.
就像外面那个 Morrison 侦探腰里别的那把……
Like the one Detective Morrison carries on his hip out there...
或者是你们这片区会用的那把。
...or the kind they use around this neighborhood.
弹壳？什么弹壳？当时差点丢了命之后，我就学乖了，只坐在屋里算账。
Casings? What casings? After I nearly died that time, I learned my lesson — I just sit in my room and do the books.
外头的烂活儿，枪，子弹，我是没碰。
The dirty work outside — the guns, the bullets — I haven't touched any of it.
对我来说……活着比什么都强。所以，Webb先生才找了个接班人。
For me... staying alive beats everything else. That's why Mr. Webb found someone to take my place.
他选接班人有什么标准？
What was his criteria for picking a replacement?
这片儿能干这种活的，多半都是……身份不大干净的人。
The kind of people who can do this work around here... they're mostly folks whose papers aren't exactly... clean.
Webb先生有渠道，能把艾斯弗德的合法身份递到他们手上。
Mr. Webb had the connections to get them legitimate Ashford identity papers.
您要问标准——大概就是，谁更想要那张纸。
You ask about criteria? I'd say... whoever wanted that piece of paper the most.
那你呢？你拿到合法身份了吗？
And you? Did you get your papers?
Webb先生守过他对我的承诺。剩下的话，您自己想吧。
Mr. Webb kept his promise to me. ...You can draw your own conclusions from that.
行了。就问到这儿。
All right. That's enough for now.
账目我这儿一直开着，Brennan 先生。您有什么要查的，随时来。
The books are always open, Mr. Brennan. Anything you need to check... come by anytime.
你什么时候进来的？
When did you come in?
最后一句。Morrison 让你在这里等？
The last line. Morrison told you to wait here?
等他回来带我走。
For him to come back and take me away.
所以你还是唱了。
So you sang anyway.
嗯。
Yes.
一个观众也没有。
Not a single person in the audience.
本来就不是唱给他们的。
It wasn't for them in the first place.
我记得。
I remember.
别给旧东西编故事。我和 Webb 不是恋人，我只是他勒索别人的工具。
Do not invent a story for an old photograph. Webb and I were not lovers. I was only a tool he used to blackmail others.
歌唱完了。你不是来听歌的。
The song is over. You didn't come here to listen.
我想问几个你上次没有回答的问题。
I want to ask about a few things you didn't answer last time.
你问吧。
Go ahead.

Parameters.ParameterStr: Rosa 对你的指认已经被推翻。你为什么还坚持认罪？
Parameters.ParameterEn: Rosa’s accusation has been disproved. Why do you still insist on confessing?
Do you know Rita?

Parameters.ParameterStr: 这张合照为什么一直留在抽屉里？
Parameters.ParameterEn: Why did you keep this photograph in your drawer?
I have no more questions.

Words: Rosa 的指认已经站不住了。她没有看见你开枪，十一点半那声也不是致命枪声。
Rosa's accusation no longer holds. She never saw you fire, and the shot at half past eleven was not the fatal one.
你真的进去了吗？
Did you actually go in?
那又怎么样？
What difference does that make?
我不知道。那一段很模糊。枪、音乐，还有后来倒在地上的 Webb，全混在了一起。
I don't know. That part is blurred. The gun, the music, and Webb lying on the floor afterward have all run together.
十一点以后，你做了什么？
What did you do after eleven?
十点到十一点，我一直在台上。十一点，我的演出结束。后面是乐队。
From ten to eleven, I was onstage. At eleven, my set ended. The band took over.
我让乐队在十一点接上 Webb 最喜欢的那首。
I told the band to follow my set at eleven with Webb's favorite song.
你准备趁他们演奏的时候进入会客室。
You meant to enter the parlor while they played.
23:05，我带着枪走到会客室，原本打算直接进去找 Webb。
At 23:05, I went to the parlor with a gun. I had meant to go straight in and find Webb.
你原本打算进去做什么？
What did you intend to do once you went in?
我要带他去跳最后一支舞。等舞曲结束，再杀了他。
I would take him for one last dance. When the music ended, I would kill him.
照片右下角写着“Ashford，1924”。为什么锁在你的私人抽屉里？
The lower-right corner says “Ashford, 1924.” Why was it locked in your private drawer?
四年前，我在 Ashford 的台上唱歌时认识了 Webb。
I met Webb four years ago, when I was singing on a stage in Ashford.
今年是 1928。你把它留了四年。
It is 1928. You kept it for four years.
忘了扔。
I forgot to throw it away.
四年。忘掉一张照片，用不了这么久。
Four years. It doesn't take that long to forget one photograph.
你到底想从一张照片里问出什么？
What exactly do you expect to get out of one photograph?
它至少证明，四年前你们就不只是普通的老板和歌女。可从上次见面开始，你就一直不肯让我们问这段关系。
At least it proves that four years ago, you were more than an employer and a singer. Yet you have refused to let us ask about that relationship.
昨天你说，这一首是唱给自己的。为什么非得在被带走以前唱完？
Yesterday you said this song was for yourself. Why did you have to finish it before they took you away?
Rita，她来了之后，Webb就不再怎么和我待在一起了。
Rita. After she arrived, Webb hardly spent any time with me.
四年前，我以为只要一直唱，总有一天就能离开 Ashford。
Four years ago, I thought that if I kept singing, one day I would get out of Ashford.
后来 Webb 把舞台变成了挑选目标的地方。
Then Webb turned the stage into a place for choosing targets.
陪客人喝酒，听他们说秘密，再把那些话带回去。唱歌反而成了最不重要的部分。
Drink with the guests, listen to their secrets, bring those secrets back. Singing became the least important part.
所以你真正想要的，是唱完以后不必再端着酒盘走进某个客人的包厢。
So what you really wanted was to finish a song without having to carry a tray into some guest's booth afterward.
……你非得把梦想说得这么难听吗？
...Do you have to make a dream sound so ugly?
难听的通常比较接近实话。
The ugly version is usually closer to the truth.
至少刚才这一首，只是因为我想唱。
At least that last song was simply because I wanted to sing.
还有一件事。刚才在歌舞厅的那首歌，你唱完了吗？
One more thing. That song in the dance hall—did you finish it?
算。我原本以为，那会是最后一首。
I did. I thought it would be my last.
这才像委托人。走吧——先撤口供，剩下的我们查到底。
Now that sounds like a client. Come on—we withdraw the confession first, then investigate the rest to the end.
我知道你们来干什么，Brennan 先生。
I know why you are here, Mr. Brennan.
你们翻过我的化妆间，也看见 Webb 留下的那些东西了。现在是想拿几张旧纸，替我编一个动人的故事吗？
You searched my dressing room and saw the things Webb left behind. Now you mean to turn a few old papers into a touching story for me?
记者小姐也回来了。看来走廊没有你想要的答案。
The reporter is back too. I suppose the corridor didn't give you the answer you wanted.
你替他接近客人，替他听秘密。这些都是你亲口说的。
You approached guests for him and listened for their secrets. You told us that yourself.
没人替他否认这件事。可你正拿这一件真事，去盖住其他所有东西。
No one is denying what he did. But you are using that one truth to cover everything else.
走廊那边已经问完了。现在该把你没说的部分补上。
I'm done in the corridor. Now you can fill in the part you left out.
那就照你刚才的说法，再说一遍。一个字也别改。
Then repeat what you just told us. Do not change a word.
我和 Webb 不是恋人。我只是他勒索别人的工具。
Webb and I were not lovers. I was only a tool he used to blackmail others.
那我昨晚拿着枪去找的，就是一个还爱着我、我也还爱着的人。
Then last night, I went there with a gun to kill a man who still loved me—and whom I still loved.
这张照片拍于 1924 年，四年前。它一直在你的私人抽屉里。不是 Webb 留着，是你留着。
This photograph was taken in 1924, four years ago. It stayed in your private drawer. Webb did not keep it. You did.
而我是真的想杀了他。所以别再替我找理由了。
And I truly wanted to kill him. So stop looking for excuses for me.
一张旧照片。你还想从上面看出什么？
An old photograph. What else do you expect to see in it?
照片可以是旧物。分手信不是。
A photograph can be an old keepsake. A breakup letter cannot.
“四年。你许下的承诺一个也没有兑现。我不是你的玩偶，也不是任你摆布的棋子。我们结束了。”
‘Four years. Not one of your promises has been kept. I am not your doll, nor a pawn for you to move as you please. We are finished.’
你们连这个也翻出来了。
You found even that.
工具不会写分手信。雇主也不会向工具许下四年的承诺。
A tool would not write a breakup letter. Nor would an employer make four years of promises to a tool.
……好。我们在一起过。
...Fine. We were together.
偷偷摸摸的四年。满意了吗？
Four years in secret. Are you satisfied?
照片是四年前，这封信写的是四年。可它没有寄出去——你想结束，却始终没有真正结束。
The photograph is from four years ago, and this letter says four years. But you never sent it—you wanted to end things, yet never truly did.
寄不寄出去又有什么区别？他从来没打算让我走。
What difference would sending it have made? He never intended to let me go.
有区别。它证明你们不只是利用关系。你想结束这段感情，却始终没把信寄出去。
It makes a difference. It proves your relationship was more than exploitation. You wanted to end it, but you never sent the letter.
恋人？一个把我送到别的男人桌边的恋人？这种关系，也配叫爱？
Lovers? A lover who sent me to other men’s tables? You call that love?
就算关系没有结束，我们之间也早就没有爱了。这些东西留着，也不过是留着一段过去。
Even if the relationship never ended, there had been no love between us for a long time. Keeping these things meant nothing more than keeping a piece of the past.
那就不谈你们在一起的那四年。谈谈他死前留下的东西。
Then we will leave aside the four years you were together and talk about what he left before he died.
这份委托协议在他死前仍然有效。全部遗产，唯一的继承人——你。
This agreement was still valid when he died. His entire estate, and one sole beneficiary—you.
补偿。或者他最后一次替我做决定。
Compensation. Or his last attempt to decide for me.
所以我们还找到了这个。垃圾桶里的信，封口完整。
That is why we also found this: a letter in the wastebasket, with its seal intact.
我认得他的字。我没有拆，也不想拆。
I recognize his hand. I did not open it, and I did not want to.
那现在听清楚。这不是我们替他编的故事，是他自己写的。
Then listen now. This is not a story we invented for him. He wrote it himself.
“四年前第一次听你唱歌的那个夜晚，我以为，只要把你留在身边，那种感觉就不会消失。直到现在，它也没有变。”
“The night I first heard you sing four years ago, I thought that if I could keep you beside me, that feeling would never fade. It has not changed, even now.”
别念了。
Stop reading.
“我不会说自己做的一切都是错的……但我确实利用了你。我以为这是保护，最后却把‘留住’变成了‘困住’。”
‘I will not say that everything I did was wrong... But I did use you. I called it protection; in the end, “keeping you” became “confining you.”’
“那份遗产不是报酬，也买不到原谅。留下、离开，或烧掉一切——这一次，由你决定。”
‘The estate is not payment, and it cannot buy forgiveness. Stay, leave, or burn it all—this time, the choice is yours.’
这不会把 Webb 变成好人。他爱你，也利用你。解除误会，不等于替他开脱。
That does not make Webb a good man. He loved you, and he used you. Clearing up the misunderstanding does not excuse him.
不可能……那张被取消的船票呢？
No... What about the canceled ticket?
是我开的……一定是我开的！别再逼我想了！
I fired it... I must have fired it! Stop forcing me to remember!
你的枪没有硝烟，也没有近期击发痕迹。它那晚没有开过火。
Your gun has no gunshot residue and no signs of recent firing. It was not fired that night.
现场弹壳是 .45，你的 Colt 是 .25。拿着枪，不等于开过枪。
The casing at the scene is a .45. Your Colt is a .25. Holding a gun is not the same as firing it.
可我记得枪在手里，也记得那声枪响……Rosa 还看见我站在尸体旁。
But I remember the gun in my hand, and I remember the shot... Rosa also saw me standing beside the body.
可我是真的以为自己杀了他。甚至希望就是我。
But I truly believed I had killed him. Part of me even hoped I had.
至于 Rita，她盯的是会客室和进出 Webb 身边的人，更像 Whale 安插的眼线。没有证据证明他们在一起。
As for Rita, she watched the parlor and everyone moving around Webb. She looks more like an informant planted by Whale. There is no evidence they were together.
那样 Morrison 把我带走，一切就结束了。
Then Morrison could take me away, and it would all be over.
你可以为杀意负责，但不能替真正的凶手偿命。活下去，也不等于原谅 Webb。
You can answer for wanting him dead, but you cannot pay for the real killer’s crime. Staying alive does not mean forgiving Webb.
所以……他没有不要我？
So... he never stopped loving me?
真正的凶手正等着你替他把案子结掉。
The real killer is waiting for you to close the case for him.
我宁可相信他变了心。因为如果他还爱我……
I would rather believe he stopped loving me. Because if he still loved me...
你唯独不记得自己扣下扳机。别让那段空白替你作证。
The one thing you do not remember is pulling the trigger. Do not let that blank in your memory testify for you.
那一枪不是我开的……我没有杀他。
I did not fire that shot... I did not kill him.
……好。别让我猜。你们问，我只说我能确定的。
...All right. Do not let me guess. Ask your questions, and I will tell you only what I know for certain.
你们找谁？James还没回来。
Who are you looking for? James is not home yet.
James还没下班。这儿没别人了。
James hasn't come home from work yet. There's nobody else here...
别紧张，太太。我叫 Zack，是个私家侦探。
Easy, ma'am. Name's Zack -- I'm a private detective...
这位是《先驱报》的记者 Emma。我们是为了蓝月亮老板的事来的。
This is Emma, a reporter with the Herald. We're here about the Blue Moon owner...
调查……你们是警察？！
An investigation... you're with the police?!...
别怕，我们不是警察。我们是受人雇佣来查清真相的，跟警局没关系。
Don't worry, we're not police. We were hired to find the truth -- we've got nothing to do with the precinct...
老板……就是报纸上说被杀的那个？
The owner... you mean the one in the papers -- the one who was killed?...
没错。我们不是来找James麻烦的，只是想随便聊两句，确认点小事。
That's right. We're not here to cause trouble for James -- just want to have a little chat, clear up a few small things...
那……你们先坐吧。
Well... have a seat, then...
您的屋子收拾得很干净。这街区可不常见。
Your home is very tidy. That isn't common in this neighborhood.
是要住人的地方，总得收拾干净些。James 每天在后厨闻够了油烟。
A home should be kept clean. James gets enough grease and smoke in that kitchen every day.
回来总得有个清爽点的地方喘口气。
He deserves somewhere clean to breathe when he comes home.
看样子，是不是快生了？
Looks like the baby's coming soon?...
嗯……也就这一个多月的事了。
Mm... just about a month or so now...
你们结婚多久了，O'Sullivan 太太？
How long have you two been married, Mrs. O'Sullivan?...
两年了，先生。
Two years now, sir...

Parameters.ParameterEn: Has James been all right lately?
How have the two of you been getting by?

Parameters.ParameterStr: 我们要找一些证明他合法身份的文件。
Parameters.ParameterEn: We need documents proving his legal status.
No more questions.

Words: 他……他最近话变少了。晚上回来就一个人坐在那儿发呆。
He... he's been talking less lately. Comes home and just sits there staring at nothing...
这样多久了？
How long has that been going on?...
也就这一两个礼拜吧，从接了那件差事之后。
A week or two, I suppose... ever since he took on that job...
他跟您抱怨过什么吗？
Has he complained about anything to you?...
他只说，等忙完这一阵子就好了。他不想说的事，我从来不问。
He just says once this stretch is over, things will get better. The things he doesn't want to talk about -- I never ask...
他从来不骗我。家里大大小小的事，全靠他一个人顶着。
He's never lied to me. Everything in this house -- big or small -- he carries it all on his own...
他舍不得吃，把最后一口面包和每一分钱都留给我。嘴上说没事，夜里却总被噩梦惊醒。
He would not eat. He saved the last bite of bread and every penny for me. He said he was fine, then woke from nightmares at night.
孩子快出生了，医院那边都联系好了吗？
With the baby coming so soon, have you arranged things with the hospital?...
哪有钱去医院啊。
Hospital? We can't afford that...
像我们这样还没拿到合法身份的人，医院的门槛高得能把人逼死。
For people like us -- people who haven't got their papers yet -- the hospital door might as well be a wall...
医院和身份文件都要钱。再凑不齐，这孩子连能不能合法留下都不知道。
The hospital and the immigration papers both cost money. If we cannot raise it, we do not even know whether the child can legally stay.
James接的那件“差事”……就是为了挣这笔钱？
That 'job' James took on... it was to earn that money?...
他说那件差事做完，就能一次付清医院费和补件的钱。
He said that job would pay the hospital bill and the immigration filing costs in one stroke.
我们的孩子就能在这座城市抬起头做人。
--our child can hold their head up high in this city...
以后，就不用像我们似的，见个穿制服的都得绕道走。
Then we won't have to cross the street every time we see a uniform...
身份文件？你们要看那个干什么？
Identity papers? What do you need those for?...
万一警察非要查他，有这些文件在手能省掉不少麻烦。
If the police decide to come after him, having those papers on hand could save him a lot of trouble--...
您肯定也不希望他平白无故被警察找借口带走吧。
--you wouldn't want the police hauling him in over nothing, would you?...
有一封补件通知，还没批。截止到11月7日，James说一定能把材料补齐。
There is a request for additional evidence. It is not approved. The deadline is November 7, and James promised he would complete it.
他最近总在写信，说联系上了一个能给我们钱的大人物。
He has been writing letters lately. He said he found an important man who could get us the money.
能彻底改变我们家的日子。
--someone who can change everything for our family...
太太，方便让我们在屋里随便看看吗？您放心，绝不乱翻。
Ma'am, would you mind letting us take a look around? We won't touch anything we shouldn't...
可能有些文件或者信件能帮上他的忙。
There might be some documents or letters that could actually help him...
你们……真的能帮他？
You... can you really help him?...
如果有人想往他身上泼脏水，

I was in the kitchen upstairs when the shot went off at 23:30. Haven't I already told you this?
现在情况不同了。我们需要你当晚详细的行动轨迹。
Things are different now. We need your detailed movements that night.
You said before... 'from 23:00 to about 23:10...
1F 客人点了夜宵，我下去送了一趟，几分钟就回去了。”
...a guest on the first floor ordered a late-night snack. I went down to deliver it -- took just a few minutes, then came back up.'
几分钟，具体是几分钟？
A few minutes. How many minutes, exactly?

If something else happened in between... seven or eight minutes would be plenty.
你们……怀疑我？
You... suspect me?

后厨那点动静都能传到一楼，更何况枪。
The racket from the kitchen carries all the way to the first floor... let alone a gunshot.
七八分钟。
Seven or eight minutes...
还有别的问题吗，先生？
Any other questions, sir?
暂时没有需要你补充的细节了。不过，确实还有一个问题。

糟糕——！
Oh no--!
你不要来烦着我！（Don't be bothering me!）
Don't be bothering me!
呼……多谢提醒，先生。要不然今晚这锅高汤全得毁了。

I still need to tend to the stock... if the two of you don't have anything else...
打扰了，O'Sullivan。
Sorry for the trouble, O'Sullivan.
随时欢迎，两位。
Anytime... you two.
我没法冷静！那是“鲸鱼”（Whale）的车！
I cannot stay calm! That is Whale's car!
James——别做傻事！
James, do not do anything stupid!
他们全听见了……刚刚的话他们全听见了！
They heard everything... they heard everything we just said!
只有我死！只有我现在死在这里，他们才会放过她！
Only if I die! Only if I die here and now will they let her go!
别拿枪！
Do not reach for the gun!
没时间了……我已经没有别的退路了！
There is no time... I have no other way out!
听着，两位！Anna 她是无辜的，她真的什么都不知道！
Listen, both of you! Anna is innocent. She truly knows nothing!
还有……拜托你们……替我保护好她……
And... please... protect her for me...
He...
James!
James!
该死……
Damn it...

他在那儿。大半夜站在风口，神情看起来像惊弓之鸟。
There he is. Standing in the wind at this hour, looking like a spooked bird...
手里空空如也，视线不断往外瞟，绝不是在等我们。
Empty hands, eyes darting toward the street. He's definitely not waiting for us...
当然不是。活儿干完了，他现在是在等主子结账。
Of course not. The job's done. He's out here waiting for his master to settle up.
Brennan 先生……O'Malley 小姐……你们……怎么会在这儿？
Mr. Brennan... Miss O'Malley... what are you... doing here?
晚上好，James。看你满头冷汗的样子，是在等那笔血淋淋的尾款吗？
Good evening, James. Sweating like that in this cold -- waiting for that blood-stained payoff, are you?
我们之间还差一场坦白局。聊聊 Webb 的死，
You and I are overdue for a little heart-to-heart. Let's talk about Webb's death...
聊聊 23:00 到底发生了什么。
Let's talk about what happened at 23:00. Oh, and while we're at it --
还可以聊聊你寄给“鲸鱼”（Whale）先生的信——
we could also discuss that letter you sent to Mr. Whale --
我……我听不懂你们在说什么。厨房太热了，我只是出来透透气……
I... I don't understand what you're talking about. The kitchen was hot... I just came out for some air...
透气？透气需要浑身发抖地躲在暗处吗？
Fresh air? Since when does fresh air require hiding in the dark, shaking like a leaf?
听不懂没关系，等我们把证据一件件摆出来，你的记忆就会恢复的。
Don't worry about understanding. Once we lay out the evidence, piece by piece, your memory will come back just fine.
怎么，不请我们进去慢慢聊吗？
What's the matter -- not going to invite us inside to talk this through?
里面……里面人多嘴杂。就在这儿说吧。你们到底想问什么？
Inside... too many ears inside. Let's just... talk here. What do you want to know?
这么急着撇清关系？
Awfully eager to clear your name, aren't you?...
可要是我说，23:30 根本不是 Webb 真正的死亡时间呢？
But what if I told you... eleven-thirty was never the real time of Webb's death at all?...
怎么不是？！枪声就是 23:30 响的，整个酒吧的人都听见了！
Of course it was! The gunshot was at 23:30 -- everyone in the bar heard it!
如果是其他时间开枪，整栋楼都会听见，根本不可能瞒得过去！
If anyone had fired at a different time, the whole building would've heard it -- there's no way to cover that up!
The gunshot at 23:30?
你是不是把这个借口在心里默念了一百遍，以至于自己都信了？
You've rehearsed that excuse so many times you've started believing it yourself, haven't you?
你说，如果有其他时间的枪响，整栋楼都会听见——确实。
You said if a gun went off at any other time, the whole building would hear it -- and you're right.
除非枪声被更大的动静盖住了。看看这个，你之前在厨房里急着烧毁的东西。
Unless the gunshot was drowned out by something louder. Take a look at this -- the thing you were so desperate to burn in that kitchen.
没烧干净的节目单碎片。上面写着《艾斯弗德狂想曲》和《爵士风暴》，
The half-burned fragments of a program. It lists the Ashford Rhapsody and Jazz Storm --
配器是完整爵士乐队，突出鼓组，音量等级被拉到了最高的 5 级！
full jazz band arrangement, heavy on the drums -- and the volume was cranked to the absolute maximum, level five!
在这种能把屋顶掀翻的强劲鼓点下，别说一声枪响，
Under that kind of roof-shaking drumbeat, forget one gunshot --
就算你在 Webb 的办公室里开十枪，外面也根本听不见一点声响！
you could've emptied ten rounds in Webb's office and no one outside would've heard a single thing!
……那、那又怎样！碎片上连具体时间都被烧掉了，只剩下一个"晚间"！
...So what?! The fragments don't even show the exact time -- all that's left is the word 'evening'!
谁能证明这首曲子到底是什么时候演奏的？
Who can prove when that piece was actually performed?!
还在挣扎？那就再看看这份，Vivian 亲笔签名的节目修改申请。
Still struggling? Then take a look at this -- Vivian's own signed program modification request.
申请上白纸黑字写着，这首 5 级音量的狂暴爵士乐，替换了原本舒缓的抒情曲，
Black and white, right there on the form -- that level-five thunderstorm of jazz replaced the original soft ballad,
演出时间被精准地定在了 23:00 到 23:10！
and the performance was scheduled precisely for 23:00 to 23:10!
这根本不是巧合，而是你精心设计的消音器。
This wasn't coincidence. It was your custom-built silencer.
真正的案发时间是 23:00 到 23:05。
The real time of death -- 23:00 to 23:05.
你借着自己 23:00-23:10 之间惯常的送餐时间，从厨房下来，
You used that 23:00-to-23:10 window -- your usual meal delivery slot -- came down from the kitchen,
杀了 Webb。至于 23:30 的枪声，不过是你为了洗脱嫌疑制造的障眼法！
and killed Webb. As for that gunshot at 23:30 -- it was nothing but a smokescreen you set up to clear your name!
No...
退一万步说，就算是 23:05……
Even if we take a huge step back... even if it was 23:05...
那时连在二楼的我都能听到 Webb 隔着门对Vivian大吼。
At that time, even from the second floor, I could hear Webb shouting at Vivian through the door.
那时Webb还活着！根本不可能是那时候动的手！
Webb was still alive then! There's no way anyone killed him at that hour!
那个声音不是 Webb 的——是你。你的口音，你在厨房就已经露馅儿了。
That voice wasn't Webb's -- it was yours. Your accent gave you away back in the kitchen.
一句在那种情况下，脱口而出的话。
One sentence. Blurted out in the heat of the moment.
“你不要来烦着我！（Don't be bothering me!）”
'Don't be bothering me!'
熟悉吗？James。这句话，
Sound familiar, James? That exact sentence --
你今天在厨房里差点被热锅烫伤时，也一字不差地吼过。
you shouted it word for word in the kitchen today, the moment that hot pan nearly burned you.
巧合！那是 Webb 说的！很多人都会这么说！
Coincidence! That was Webb! Plenty of people say that!
Vivian 听见的就是 Webb 的声音！
Vivian heard Webb's voice! It was Webb!
很多人？你确定吗？看看这份 Anna 的合法移民通过通知。
Plenty of people? You sure about that? Take a look at Anna's legal immigration approval notice.
原籍，爱尔兰科克郡。
Place of origin -- County Cork, Ireland.
附件里还有你的非配额移民资格书。你以为没人去查你的底细吗？
The attachment includes your non-quota immigration eligibility papers. Did you think no one would dig into your background?
你根本不是本地人，你是一个地地道道的爱尔兰非法移民，James。
You're not a local at all. You're a bona fide illegal Irish immigrant, James.
再对比一下你在厨房脱口而出的那句话！
Now compare that with the sentence you blurted out in the kitchen today!
“你不要来烦着我！（Don't be bothering me!）”
'Don't be bothering me!'
这种典型的爱尔兰倒装句法，
That classic Irish inverted construction --
土生土长的美国人 Webb，一辈子也说不出来！
a born-and-bred American like Webb could never have said it in his life!
23:05，Webb 早就成了一具尸体。
At 23:00-oh-five, Webb was already a corpse.
站在门后，隔着门捏着嗓子模仿老板，把 Vivian 骗走的人——就是你！
The one standing behind that door, disguising his voice to send Vivian away -- that was you!
你们……
You...
James，你不是没有动机。你就是因为钱杀了 Webb。
James, you had a motive. You killed Webb for money.
没有。我没缺到那种程度，也没那么急。Webb 会给我的。
No. I wasn't that desperate, and it wasn't that urgent. Webb was going to pay me.
那就看看这份通知。
Then look at this notice.
它不是批准书，是移民局的补件通知。日期和截止期限都写得清清楚楚。
It isn't an approval letter. It's an immigration evidence request, with the date and deadline written plainly.
Anna 必须限期补交费用凭证和经济担保证明。
Anna had to submit fee receipts and proof of financial support by the deadline.
逾期，申请就会被拖延，甚至失效。你说这不急？
Miss the deadline, and the application could be delayed or even lapse. You call that not urgent?
再听听 Anna 亲口说了什么。
Now listen to what Anna told us herself.
孩子快出生了，医院费用和身份文件都在等着钱。
The baby is almost due, and both the hospital costs and identity papers need money.
她说你们家急需一大笔钱。不是以后，是现在。
She said your family urgently needed a large sum. Not later. Now.
这就是你等不起的理由。
That's why you couldn't afford to wait.
是，我是急……可 Webb 会给我的！
Yes, I was pressed... but Webb was going to pay me!
我只是替他做那些脏活。那是 Webb 欠我的钱，
I only did his dirty work. That was money Webb owed me,
不是“鲸鱼”（Whale）给我的钱！
not money from Whale!
我只是没告诉你们我替 Webb 勒索别人！这难道光彩吗？
I just didn't tell you I was extorting people for Webb! Is that something to be proud of?!
可这跟“鲸鱼”（Whale）没有关系。
But that has nothing to do with Whale.
我从来不认识什么“鲸鱼”。
I don't know anyone called Whale.
没见过。那先听听 Tommy 是怎么说的。
Never met him. Then let's hear what Tommy had to say.
在这家酒吧里，除了 Webb 和 Tommy，
In this entire bar, besides Webb and Tommy --
唯一还知道"鲸鱼"（Whale）存在的，
the only other person who even knew Whale existed --
就只有那个贪得无厌的现任勒索者。
was the one greedy enough to take over the extortion.
你对“鲸鱼”（Whale）的事一清二楚——因为你就是那个现任勒索者！
You knew everything about Whale -- because you ARE that current extortionist!
还有这封信。
And then there's this letter.
从你公寓桌角找到的。一封你写给“鲸鱼”（Whale）的回信。
Found on the corner of your desk at home. A reply letter you wrote to Whale.
上面写着：今晚 20:00，后门。你亲手回了他的约。
It says: tonight, 20:00, back door. You answered his summons yourself.
你联系过他。你们之间，不只是听说过名字。
You contacted him. This wasn't just a name you'd heard.
你不是不认识"鲸鱼"（Whale）——
It wasn't that you didn't know Whale --
你已经在等他给你的尾款。
you were already waiting for the balance he owed you.
不……我不是想让所有人都毁掉。
No... I never wanted everyone to be destroyed.
你们不明白。要是，我把他们的事告诉了警察的话……
You do not understand. If I tell the police about them...
等等，Emma。
Wait, Emma.
……什么声音？
...What was that sound?
不……不！他们怎么会提前来？！
No... no! How did they come early?!
该死……该死的艾斯弗德。
Damn it... damn Ashford.
“鲸鱼”的人……没有跟过来吧？
The Whale's people... they didn't follow us, right?
……Brennan。
...Brennan.
说。
Speak.
James 开枪的时候，我离他……不到三步。
When James fired, I was... less than three steps away.
我们上一秒明明还在想办法帮他安全转移 Anna 的……为什么……
One second earlier we were still trying to help him move Anna somewhere safe... why...
如果我们没有顺藤摸瓜找上门，“鲸鱼”的人就不会提前赶来灭口……
If we hadn't followed the trail to their door, the Whale's people wouldn't have come early to silence him...
我以为我们在查明真相，结果是我们亲手把他往那把枪上推。
I thought we were uncovering the truth. Instead, we pushed him toward that gun with our own hands.
我们走的比较快，“鲸鱼”（Whale）的人应该没看到我们的脸。
We moved fast. The Whale's people probably didn't see our faces.
是我们俩的决定要了他的命！
Our decision got him killed!
是我当着“鲸鱼”的人的面，清楚地说出了James和他们的勾结。
I was the one who said, clearly and in front of the Whale's people, that James was working with them.
不是你的错，Emma。
This wasn't your fault, Emma.
但好在，他们还不知道你长什么样。退出吧。趁现在。
But luckily, they still don't know what you look like. Walk away. While you still can.
O'Malley，看着我。逼迫James扣下扳机的不是我们，而是“我”。
O'Malley, look at me. It wasn't us who forced James to pull the trigger. It was me.
难受的话，就把一切都交给我吧。你已经很努力了。
If it hurts, leave all of it to me. You've already done enough.
什么意思——你在赶我走？
What do you mean -- are you trying to send me away?
“鲸鱼”的人既然能在这里逼死他，接下来就是不留活口。
If the Whale's people could force him to die here, next they'll leave no witnesses.
不，我不走。
No. I'm not leaving.
你不怕死吗？
Aren't you afraid of dying?
怕。我现在的腿是软的。
Yes. My legs are shaking right now.
但我在这里不是因为不怕。是因为我清楚这件事值得。
But I'm not here because I'm fearless. I'm here because I know this is worth it.
刚才有个人在你面前把自己的脑袋打碎了！
Someone just blew his own brains out right in front of you!
我知道我看见了什么。如果我现在转身，他才是白死了。
I know what I saw. If I turn around now, he died for nothing.
James 把 Anna 托付给了我们。
James entrusted Anna to us.
你跟着蹚这浑水，万一出事，你去向谁交代？
If you wade into this mess and something happens, who are you supposed to answer to?
听到那声枪响的时候，我已经接下了这个重量。
When I heard that gunshot, I had already taken on that weight.
这条命的交代，不是你一个人替我接的。
This life is not something you took on for me alone.
我没想代替你。
I wasn't trying to replace you.
那就不要在这个时候替我做决定。
Then don't make decisions for me right now.
Anna 需要的不是看护人，而是一个不用再提心吊胆的未来。
Anna doesn't need a babysitter. She needs a future where she doesn't have to live in fear anymore.
还有牢里的 Vivian……这件事必须由我来走到头。
And Vivian in jail... I have to see this through to the end.
Morrison 背后站着 Whale。我一个人去，就没有软肋。
Whale stands behind Morrison. If I go alone, I have no weak spot.
带着你，你就是用来威胁我的把柄。
If I bring you, you become the leverage they use against me.
收起孤胆英雄那套吧。你一个人去，他总能找到别的东西逼你就范。
Drop the lone hero act. If you go alone, he'll always find something else to force you to fold.
比如什么？
Like what?
你自己清楚。
You know exactly what.
在那个办公室里，你需要见证人。得有一张《先驱报》的记者证放在桌上。
In that office, you need a witness. There needs to be a Herald reporter's press pass on the desk.
那可是比私家侦探执照更让他投鼠忌器。你没法把我剔除出去。
That will make him more cautious than a private detective's license. You can't cut me out.
从现在起，这已经不是普通的调查委托了。
From now on, this isn't a normal investigation anymore.
从看到 Rosa 女儿照片那天起，就已经不是了。
It hasn't been since the day I saw the photo of Rosa's daughter.
我不走。这是我的选择，不是你的决定。
I am not leaving. This is my choice, not your decision.
……好。算你赢。
...Fine. You win.
所以，先给你这个……
So, first, take this...
……他倒下去的时候，那声音……很沉。我脑子里嗡的一下，什么都没了。

Words: 你是……Whale？

反应很快，Brennan。看来我的名字已经引起了你们足够的重视。
Quick reaction, Brennan. It seems my name has caught enough of your attention.
你到底想干什么？
What do you want?
你是……Morrison？
You are... Morrison?
顺着我的气味像猎犬一样死咬了一晚上……
You have been clinging to my scent like a hound all night...
结果到现在，你脑子里除了那些廉价的正义感，
and after all that, besides that cheap sense of justice,

the only thing in your head is that idiot Morrison?
