慌不择路地吞了枪。
and in his panic, he swallowed the gun.
替我处理了这个麻烦，我该谢谢你们才对。
You dealt with that nuisance for me. I should thank you.
继续挖，Brennan。聪明人总以为危险只盯着自己。
Keep digging, Brennan. Clever men always think danger has eyes only for them.
等你回头时，先被拖进泥潭的，往往是那个站在岸边等你回家的人。
When you finally look back, the first person dragged into the mire is often the one waiting on shore for you to come home.
你们说得像真的一样。
You make it sound like the truth.
钱、Anna、Vivian……这些名词摆在一起，就能说明什么吗？
Money, Anna, Vivian... you put those words together and that proves something?
如果你们真的了解我做了什么，就别一句一句地吓我！
If you really knew what I did, stop trying to scare me one sentence at a time!

but that does not mean someone else should have to pay with their life!
Webb 死了。Vivian 差点替你上绞架。
Webb is dead. Vivian almost went to the gallows for you.
Rosa 被你逼到崩溃，她女儿也被你拿来威胁。

你现在还想装成那个没有选择的人吗？
And now you still want to pretend you had no choice?
他们会先找到 Anna，然后会找到孩子。到那时候，警局保护不了她的。

我可以给你们东西。信、钱、名字……我都能给。
I can give you things. Letters, money, names... I can give you all of it.
求你们，给我一点时间。让我先保证 Anna 的安全……
Please, give me a little time. Let me make sure Anna is safe first...

求求你们……千万别让她知道她的丈夫是个杀人犯！
Please... do not ever let her know her husband was a murderer!

Where is Anna now?
离这儿不远。我带你们去。

等等。你抽屉里也藏着一枚弹壳。

把抽屉关上，Brennan。那不是你的证物。

同样的底印。你跟案发那把枪，是什么关系？

几年前的旧账。跟Webb今晚的死没有半点关系。

二位慢走。

所以，这就是你的目的？去拿 Morrison 从现场带走的那枚弹壳？
So that was your purpose—to recover the casing Morrison took from the crime scene?
你怎么知道他会把它藏在家里？
How did you know he would hide it at home?
赌一把罢了。
It was a gamble.
要是他拿走弹壳，却没有上交，就说明他不敢让它进证物室。

可他也不敢随便丢掉。那东西一旦被别人捡到，他更解释不清。

……真是疯得很有道理。
...That is an alarmingly reasonable kind of madness.
可刚才从书房出来时，Morrison 太太显然察觉到了。

她一定会立刻给 Morrison 打电话。你拿走弹壳的事，说不定已经被他知道了。

所以我们要赶在他完全反应过来之前，去警局指证他。
Which is why we confront him at the station before he has time to react.
去警局？如果他像之前一样直接拔枪呢？

他把弹壳藏在自己家里，说明他压 Vivian 的案子不是公事，是私事。
Hiding the casing at home proves that burying Vivian's case was personal, not police work.
只要当着其他警察的面，把弹壳、James 的枪和 Whale 的借款记录摆出来，他就不能再用手枪把事情盖过去。
Once we lay out the casing, James's gun, and Whale's loan record in front of the other officers, he cannot bury this with a pistol.
所以我们现在该做的是——
So what we do now is—
带上所有证据，赶在 Morrison 来找我们之前，打他个措手不及。
Take every piece of evidence and catch Morrison off guard before he comes looking for us.

23:05. You are standing outside the parlor. What is the first thing you can remember?
音乐很响。我的手压在枪上……然后是门里的那句话。
The music was loud. My hand was pressed against the gun... then came the words from behind the door.
“你不要来烦着我！（Don't be bothering me!）”
“Don't be bothering me!”
你进去了吗？
Did you go in?
没有。至少那一次没有。那句话把我钉在了门外。
No. Not that time, at least. Those words pinned me outside the door.
23:30。钟响以后，你看见了什么？
23:30. What did you see after the clock struck?
23:30 的那声枪响，果然不是从你手里的枪发出的。
The shot at 23:30 did not come from the gun in your hand after all.
它来自二楼，是一声故意误导案发时间的假枪声。现场证据还证明，真正杀死 Webb 的枪响早于 23:20——有人在你之前进过会客室。

It came from the second floor—a staged shot meant to mislead us about the time of the murder. The evidence also proves the shot that killed Webb came before 23:20. Someone entered the parlor before you did.
但我不明白的是……为什么没有人听到真正杀死 Webb 的那声枪响？
But one thing still does not make sense... Why did no one hear the shot that actually killed Webb?
我端着托盘推门进去，Webb 已经倒在地上。紧接着，那声闷响从头顶压了下来。
I pushed the door open with the tray in my hands, and Webb was already on the floor. Then that muffled shot came down from above me.
Brennan，我以《先驱报》记者的身份请求你——把这件事查完。
Brennan, as a reporter for the Herald, I'm asking you—see this through.
为什么？
Why?
Webb 防着所有人。能在他毫无防备时接近他的，除了我，只有他身边那几个得力助手。
Webb was wary of everyone. Other than me, only a few of his trusted lieutenants could approach him while his guard was down.
可他们靠 Webb 吃饭，没有理由杀他。只有我有。
But they depended on Webb. They had no reason to kill him. I did.
不。你只是不知道他们的理由。
No. You just don't know their reasons.
有区别吗？
Is there a difference?
有。你没有想起自己开枪，只是因为想不到别人为什么开枪，就替凶手认了罪。
There is. You didn't remember firing. You just couldn't imagine why anyone else would, so you confessed for the killer.
我带着枪去过，也确实想杀他。
I went there with a gun. I really did want to kill him.
那证明你有计划，不能证明你完成了它。
That proves you had a plan. It doesn't prove you carried it out.
……可我真的想不起来了。
...But I truly can't remember.
Webb 最近常和 Rita 待在一起。你认识她吗？
Webb had been spending a great deal of time with Rita. Do you know her?
不认识。
No.
你回答得太快了。

因为没什么好认识的。那个女人一出现，Webb 的心思就全跟着她走了。
Because there was nothing worth knowing. The moment that woman appeared, Webb’s attention followed her everywhere.
你是说，他因为 Rita 改变了原来的安排。
You mean he changed his previous plans because of Rita.
我没这么说。
I did not say that.
那原来的安排是什么？
Then what were the previous plans?

...I do not want to talk about her.
我差点忘了，我最开始想唱歌的时候，根本还不认识他。
I almost forgot that when I first dreamed of singing, I did not even know him.
那个梦想不是 Webb 给你的，也不会因为他死了就跟着埋掉。巴黎船票可以取消，你自己的声音不行。
Webb did not give you that dream, and it does not have to be buried with him. A ticket to Paris can be canceled. Your own voice cannot.
刚才那一首留给过去。下一首唱什么、去哪里唱，我自己选。
That song was for the past. What I sing next—and where I sing it—I will choose for myself.
很好。先去撤口供。活着的委托人才有机会付尾款。

Brennan，非得现在提钱？

我是在帮她规划未来。未来通常很贵。

那你最好把真正的凶手找出来。我不付抓错人的侦探。

别再盯着那只玻璃柜了。你们要的不是影子，是能带走的原件。

Danny 把这些交给你，换银行闭嘴？
